_about: Special moves of the battle units, gathered from the original Flash client (Social Empires 0926) and written in our own words for client/src/rules/battle.ts. 'auto' lists the specials that some units play by themselves while fighting; 'units' lists the units that have attack buttons (up to four, plus a LIMIT on some); 'framework' says how the buttons, cooldowns and limit bar work. Conventions: a sprite frame is animation*5 + direction; animation 6 to 14 are special 1 to 9 (6 = special 1). Times are in frames (30 a second) unless a field says seconds or ms. 'attack' means the unit's current attack (after bonuses); 'config attack' means the base value from the game config. Damage, unless a rule says otherwise, goes through the normal damage formula of a hit (defence, dome, siege factors, random spread, critical). 'radius' is Euclidean distance in tiles. Every unit with buttons fights normally between moves; 'passive' says what else it does on its own. Minion ids are unit ids from the game config.
framework: Buttons. Each unit with buttons runs a one-second timer while in battle. A button is idle, casting or cooling down. Pressing a button only works when every button of that unit is idle (one shared state per unit, so one cooldown blocks all buttons), except the LIMIT slot (slot 4), which ignores the state. Pressing starts the cast: the unit plays the button's animation, and the effect fires when the cast time runs out; a cast time of 0 means the effect fires on the next whole-second tick. Then the cooldown starts: 25 seconds for almost every unit, 24 seconds for a few (the Creator family and those noted in their entry). Uses are unlimited (-1) for every button. Some buttons have an extra check (for example at most 3 minions alive) and stay greyed out while it fails. LIMIT. Limit units fill a bar from 0 to 2000 (500 for the Dragon Hunter family). The bar grows by the damage the unit deals (or the health it heals, for the healing limit units), at most once every 30 frames, doubled when a limit-adder unit of the same side stands within 10 tiles, and not while the limit itself is running. The bar is not saved between battles; the Instant Limit spell fills it. The LIMIT button works only when the bar is full and empties it when the cast ends. Limit kinds: lightning beams (50 beams, one every 100 ms, each 0.2 x attack to a random enemy in range); healing beams (same pacing, each heals 0.6 x config attack to a hurt unit of its own side in range); smash (every enemy unit within range, up to 20, takes attack x 2 and is thrown); special (unit's own effect, see its entry). Eggs and minions. A spawn button lays its egg 4 to 8 tiles ahead of the unit, towards its target; the minion hatches there and attacks. Unless noted, at most 3 of a unit's minions can be alive. Timed attacks repeat their effect every 500 ms for their duration unless noted. Common status effects: stun throws the unit up for 0.5 s, down for 0.5 s, then it stands helpless for 1.5 s (bosses and units with population 4 or more are immune unless the entry gives another limit); 'push' throws a unit about half the given distance away to the nearest free tile and leaves it helpless for about 1 s (bosses, giants and already helpless units are immune); poison ticks every 3 s and spreads to neighbours within 1 tile. Quirks of the original kept for fidelity: area spells cast by these units only hit the computer's side, and minions always join the player's side, so these moves work as intended only for the player's units.

auto.name: Warrior Princess whirlwind
auto.rules: Needs a target. On each of the 4 diagonal tiles next to her, the first live enemy (unit or building) whose tile it is takes her attack.

auto.name: Prince Arthur fire stream

params.tiles: 1 to 4 tiles straight ahead in her facing (diagonal facings step one tile on one axis, the others on both)

auto.rules: Four blue flames, one tile further every 10 frames; each hits the first enemy standing on its tile 15 frames after it appears, for his attack.

auto.name: Ranger (no special)
auto.rules: No automatic special. Shoots plain arrows (projectile 1), range 6.

auto.name: Wizard (no special)
auto.rules: No automatic special. Shoots a lightning bolt (projectile 8), range 8. The evil blue wizard and the castle wizard use the same bolt.

auto.name: Valkyrie healing
auto.rules: Her own villagers, clerics, footmen, knights and archers within 2 tiles (20 at most, not inside a building) each heal by her attack value (never above their base life). Fires on every beat in the window (usually 2).

auto.name: Willy Wallace war cry
auto.rules: His own villagers, clerics, footmen, knights and archers within 2 tiles (the first 10) attack 10 frames faster for 140 frames, then go back to their base interval. Wallace himself is only tinted. Each beat in the window starts a new aura (about 3).

auto.name: Thor lightning
auto.rules: Each tile of the 5x5 around him has a 30% chance of a lightning strike, landing within about 1.2 s and hitting the first enemy on that tile for his attack. Every beat in the 140-frame window does this again (about 4 times). Separately, every normal hit of Thor also throws a unit target 1 tile (push 2 = 1 tile away, then lands).

auto.name: High Elf / Anubis duplicates
auto.rules: If no copies are out: two full copies of the same item (full base life and attack, same side, half transparent) appear on the nearest free tiles. After 600 frames they fade for a second and are removed, and he can copy himself again at a later special. Copies never copy themselves. Anubis Avatar (612) and Evil Anubis (670) use interval 210, length 30.

auto.name: Royal Swordsman / Royal Knight
auto.rules: Only a different animation: beats in the window hit the target for the normal attack (in the special animation only; a beat while still walking does nothing).

auto.name: Royal Archer
auto.rules: Only a different animation: beats in the window shoot the normal arrow, with no shot delay.

auto.name: Elephant stomp

params.stun: units with population under 4, not bosses or eagles: up 0.5 s, down 0.5 s, then 1.5 s helpless

auto.rules: 15 frames later, every enemy unit within 2 tiles (20 at most) is knocked down and takes half the attack. Repeats on each beat in the window.

auto.name: Infernal Warrior stomp
auto.rules: As the elephant stomp, landing 25 frames later.

auto.name: Infernal Halberdier
auto.rules: A stomp (as the Infernal Warrior) plus the Warrior Princess's diagonal whirlwind on the same beat.

auto.name: Infernal Demon / Elf Tiger / Royal Elf whirlwind
auto.rules: The Warrior Princess's diagonal whirlwind.

auto.name: Infernal Knight fire stream
auto.rules: Prince Arthur's stream with red fire.

auto.name: Infernal Archer fire arrows
auto.rules: Ten fire arrows on random tiles of the 5x5 around its target; each hits the first enemy on its tile. (The original's check against repeating a tile does not work, so tiles can repeat.)

auto.name: Balrog (Juggernaut)

params.special1: stun wave (delay 10, radius 2, attack/2) + diagonal whirlwind (attack)
params.special2: storm of 20 fire meteors (particle 23), radius 2 around its target, attack each, delay 20 + 0..10, hit after 15

auto.rules: Alternates two specials: first the stomp and whirlwind (animation 6, 45 frames), next time the meteor storm (animation 7, 70 frames). It has range 4 but fights in melee.

auto.name: King Arthur fire line
auto.rules: Five red flames in a line ahead of him, 10 frames apart, his attack each.

auto.name: Elf Druid roots
auto.rules: With interval 0 the druid is almost always in the special: a beat there grows roots on its target's tile that hit whatever enemy stands there 15 frames later for its attack (instead of the normal shot). A beat in the 2 frames between windows shoots normally.

auto.name: Red Wizard fire rain
auto.rules: Casts the fire rain spell's picture on its target. In the original the spell's hit function is never set, so the hit throws an error and does nothing: in effect no damage, and its normal shots (fireballs, projectile 9) stop during the 100-frame window. It fires on any beat outside the attack animation, even while walking.

auto.name: Giant Viper eats
auto.rules: Once per window: it stops attacking and bites 5 times, 0.9 s apart. Each bite takes the nearest enemy unit within 10 tiles; if it is a unit with base life 350 or less and not a boss, its tail grabs it, drags it in and eats it (damage = its base life + 100, dealt twice: it dies). Otherwise the tail strikes a random tile within 5 for nothing. Then it walks again. The Colossal Cobra (709) and the Catapult (521) share this delegate; the cobra's spit also poisons (attack/2 every 3 s, 3 times).

auto.name: Catapult (side effect)
auto.rules: It inherits the viper's timing but has no special: every attack throws 4 rocks, and beats inside the 200-frame window deal no normal hit. Probably an accident of the original.

auto.name: Healer heal
auto.rules: Healers are almost always in the special: a beat heals their target (an own unit) by their attack. They never deal damage.

auto.name: Engineer repair
auto.rules: Heals (repairs) its target unit by its attack.

auto.name: Monk conversion

params.not: bosses, boss adds, eagles, units that cannot be converted

auto.rules: Its target unit changes sides and turns aggressive; one at a time (it waits for the conversion effect, 720 frames) and 4 per monk in all. Converted player units count as lost in an assault.

auto.name: Isis Healer
auto.rules: Heals its target unit by its attack on every beat, by twice its attack during the special window.

auto.name: Stone Golem slam
auto.rules: The diagonal whirlwind, also throwing units (push 2).

auto.name: Big Golem / Giant Yeti (bosses and summons)

params.special1: ring: the first enemy on each tile of the 5x5 minus its own row and column takes 50 and units are thrown 2 tiles
params.special2: falling stones: 50% of the tiles of a 6x6 square centred 4 tiles ahead get a stone (particle 3) dealing 50 after 60..180 + 30 frames
params.special3: summons 4 golems (537) or yetis (544) at the corners 3 tiles away, on its side

auto.rules: Three specials in turn, each fired on every beat inside its 60-frame window (so a summon can happen twice). The 50 is the fixed DAMAGE_SPECIAL_GOLEM.

auto.name: Golden Golem / Black Yeti

params.special1: ring 9x9 minus row and column, 100 each, throw 2
params.special2: stones on 50% of a 12x12 square 4 tiles ahead, 100 each
params.special3: summons 9 golems (537) or yetis (544) on a 3x3 grid 4 tiles apart

auto.rules: The same three specials doubled.

auto.name: Lightning Draggy bolt
auto.rules: A huge bolt on its target's tile: double attack to the first enemy there. Normal shots are lightning (8).

auto.name: Celestial Priest / Celestial Reaper sweep
auto.rules: Every enemy (units and buildings) within its range, 10 at most, takes half its attack; units are thrown.

auto.name: Gryphon Knight dive
auto.rules: At frame 30 of the special, up to 4 enemies within its range take half its attack; units are thrown.

auto.name: Celestial Mech sweep

params.sector: the quarter (or half-plane) in its facing

auto.rules: Enemy units within 2 tiles on the side it faces are thrown and take its attack.

auto.name: Celestial Lancer (no effect)
auto.rules: Only an animation; beats in the window are lost. Normal shot: a lance.

auto.name: White Wizard healing
auto.rules: The Valkyrie's heal. Normal attack: a light beam that holds while the wizard keeps attacking.

auto.name: Black Wizard skeletons
auto.rules: Raises skeleton mages (718) on free tiles next to it until 3 are alive. Normal shot: a ghostly skull (33).

auto.name: T-Rex

params.special1: eat: the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, if a unit with base life 350 or less and not a boss, is swallowed and dies at frame 69
params.special2: tail sweep: for 16 frames a 3-tile ray turns a full circle; the first enemy on each tile it passes takes its attack and units are thrown 1-2 tiles, once per frame (a unit can be hit several times)

auto.rules: Alternates eat and tail sweep.

auto.name: Fire T-Rex

params.special1: burns its target: its attack every 0.8 s, 5 times

auto.rules: Three specials in turn.

auto.name: Monster Mole cracks
auto.rules: Once per window: cracks open on about 10% of the tiles within 5; each swallows (kills) the computer side's units within 1 tile (not bosses). The spell code always picks the computer's side. Its normal hits throw the target 1 tile.

auto.name: Amazon whirlwind
auto.rules: She locks into a spin for about 5 seconds: at frame 41 and then every second, every enemy unit within 2 tiles is thrown and takes attack/2.2.

auto.name: Avenging Paladin

params.special1: 0.3 s later its target takes double attack
params.special2: spin for 5 s: every second enemy units within 2 tiles are thrown and take attack/2.2
params.special3: stands helpless 2 s, then heals itself by 100

auto.rules: Three specials in turn (the code forces the order).

auto.name: Water Wizard hurricane
auto.rules: Summons one hurricane (728) on a random free tile near it for 20 s; one at a time. It is always added on the player's side. Normal attack: a water beam.

auto.name: Werewolf curse
auto.rules: Its target unit (not a boss, convertible) is removed and replaced by a werewolf on the attacker's side with 300 life, poisoned for good. A werewolf made this way cannot curse again. Its normal hits throw the target half a tile, half the time.

auto.name: Golden Dragon Boss quake
auto.rules: Up to 6 enemies within its range take 1.5x attack; units are thrown. Its normal attack fires two golden projectiles. Immune to shocks, freezing, burning, poison, throws and conversion.

auto.name: Deadly Dragon Boss eggs
auto.rules: Throws eggs that hatch black babies (725) until 3 are alive. It takes no damage except from the quest's scripted hits, and is immune to the same effects as the golden boss.

auto.name: Scorpion

params.special1: sting: its target takes its attack and is poisoned (attack/2 every 3 s, 5 times)
params.special2: grab: if exactly 2 able enemy units with base life 350 or less are within 4 tiles, both are grabbed and die at frame 54

auto.rules: Alternates sting and grab.

auto.name: Valkyr war cry
auto.rules: Wallace's aura, once per window.

auto.name: Antimatter Wizard black hole
auto.rules: Up to 8 able enemy units with base life 350 or less within 6 tiles are sucked into the hole and die. Normal shot: antimatter (53).

auto.name: Sun Wizard
auto.rules: Up to 8 able enemy units within 6 tiles of the burst take its attack, burn 14 a second for 10 s and stay helpless for 10 s.

auto.name: Scary Zombie

params.special1: poison cloud spell (area 2) two tiles ahead: poisons the computer side's units (spell numbers 15/20/25 a tick by spell level)
params.special2: throws its own head at the target (projectile 30): the unit hit is thrown 1 tile; the zombie waits for the head to come back

auto.rules: Alternates. The poison spell always targets the computer's side.

auto.name: Earth Wizard

params.special1: if its target is a unit and it has cast fewer than 2: a crack (area 5, radius 3) at the target swallows the computer side's units; otherwise as special 2
params.special2: 10 falling boulders (particle 26) on random tiles of the 5x5 around its target, its attack each

auto.rules: Once per window each. Normal shot: a boulder (13).

auto.name: Winged Knight spear

params.area: 5x5 around itself minus its own tile

auto.rules: Once per window: the first enemy unit on each of the 24 tiles around it takes its attack and is thrown.

auto.name: Furious Dragon

params.special1: up to 4 enemies within range take attack/2; units thrown 1 tile
params.special2: egg 4-8 tiles ahead hatching a red baby (638), while fewer than 3 were made

auto.rules: Alternates; every beat outside the normal attack animation runs the current special. The baby counter only ever grows, so it stops after 3 eggs.

auto.name: Stormy Dragon

params.special1: up to 4 enemies within range take attack/2; units thrown 1 tile
params.special2: egg hatching a lightning baby (651) while fewer than 3 are alive
params.special3: huge bolt on its target: double attack

auto.rules: Three specials in turn. Normal attack: an electricity beam that shocks for show.

limit.rules: Heals up to 5 of its own units within 7 tiles by 500 each.

attacks.name: Ultra Fireball
attacks.rules: Four times in the animation: up to 5 enemy units within 3 tiles take its attack and are poisoned (5 every 3 s, 5 times).

units.passive: Its normal attack is a slow antimatter fireball (projectile 53) shot half a second after the swing.

attacks.rules: A beam along its facing: its own tile, the two tiles beside the first step, and 8 tiles straight on. The first enemy on each tile takes double attack, is thrown 1 to 5 tiles and burns for half its attack a second for 5 seconds.

attacks.name: Ataque Subito
attacks.rules: Same line as the laser (7 tiles straight on), double attack and a throw, no burning.

attacks.name: Subidon de Moral
attacks.rules: Like Wallace's aura but lasting 220 frames: up to 10 of its own footmen, archers, knights, clerics and villagers within 2 tiles attack 10 frames faster.

attacks.name: Lluvia Laser
attacks.rules: 40 laser beams on random tiles of the 5x5 around its target (or itself), each hitting whatever stands on its tile for 1.6x attack. It cannot move while casting.

units.passive: Its normal attack is a light beam (projectile 26).

attacks.name: ares_sword

params.area: 3x3 block one step ahead (diagonal step for the four diagonal facings)

attacks.rules: The first enemy on each tile of a 3x3 block just in front takes double attack; units are stunned (knocked down for 2.5 s; not bosses, only population under 4).

attacks.name: ares_pincer
attacks.rules: Its target, if within 3 tiles, takes a flat 350 (through the normal damage formula).

attacks.name: ares_whirlwind

params.area: 5x5 around it minus its own row and column (16 tiles)

attacks.rules: Spins for 9 seconds; every second the first enemy on each of 16 tiles around it takes half its attack and is thrown 2 tiles.

attacks.name: ares_bubble
attacks.rules: A magma bubble: every enemy unit (not bosses, not already disabled) within 5 tiles burns for 8 a second for 10 seconds.

attacks.rules: For 5 seconds, on frames 21 and 30 of each loop it picks the nearest enemy in range and fires two golden lasers; only the first deals its attack.

attacks.rules: For 10 seconds, twice per loop: up to 10 throwable enemy units within 2 tiles take a quarter of its attack and are thrown 3 tiles. It can keep walking.

attacks.rules: Throws an egg 4 to 8 tiles ahead; a baby (2001) hatches there. At most 3 alive.

units.passive: Its normal attack is a beam (projectile 'egyptian beam').

attacks.rules: Stands still for 8 seconds firing pairs of fireballs at the nearest enemy in range five times per loop; each pair deals half its attack.

attacks.rules: 45 coloured balls fall on random tiles of the 11x11 around its target, each hitting the first enemy on its tile for 0.65x attack.

attacks.name: Energy Whirlwind
attacks.rules: For 12 seconds, four times per loop: up to 10 throwable enemy units within 2 tiles take its attack and are pulled in then thrown 2 tiles; the first 5 hit are poisoned for good (5 every 3 s until they die).

attacks.name: Spawn Draggies

attacks.rules: For 3 seconds, twice per loop: throwable enemy units within 2 tiles are hit; the first 3 whose base life is 350 or less are swallowed (killed), the rest take a third of its attack and are pulled in and thrown 2 tiles.

attacks.rules: One explosion: the first enemy on each of the 25 tiles around it takes 1.5x attack; units also burn (a fifth of its attack a second for 5 s) and are thrown 4 tiles. It cannot act for 5 seconds.

beats.name: Necro base (all Necro units and the Spectrum Dragon)
beats.notes: Not registered for any id itself: it is the base of the 19 Necro classes (ids listed are theirs; none overrides the kill hook). No beat moves. Each time one of these units kills an enemy UNIT (not a building) - by any damage credited to it - there are 3 chances in 10 that a skeleton rises on the victim's tile, on the killer's side: Sword Skeleton 808, Axe Skeleton 797 or Skeleton Archer 818, one of the three at random (equal odds). It is marked summoned and dies by itself after 15 seconds (450 frames) unless killed first. A big lightning picture shows where it rises. The Necro Rhino 817 is NOT on this base (it uses HellRhinoDelegate).
needs: onKill hook: when a unit of these ids kills an enemy unit (not a building), with chance 0.3 add a summoned unit on the victim's tile, on the killer's side, picked uniformly from [808, 797, 818]; it dies (kill, no killer) after 450 frames if still alive. No limit on how many.

beats.name: Dome base (Protection Dome, Tower Enhancer)
beats.notes: A building, not a unit; the base of DomeProtectionDelegate (1357, 1358) and DomeTowerEnhancer (1359), not registered itself. Looks only: the dome glows; when selected it draws its range as a flat ring on the ground and a half see-through dome over it; when only hovered (not selected) just the ground ring. Ring width 108 x (range x 1.5) px, height half that. Default tint red. No battle behaviour here; the dome rules are elsewhere.

beats.name: Oil Tower
beats.notes: A tower. Every beat (its interval 70 frames) it shoots nothing (the plain shot never happens) and pours fire on a fixed row of 7 tiles beside it, chosen by its rotation (frame 0: tiles x-3..x+3 at y+1; frame 1: x+1, y-3..y+3; frame 2: x-3..x+3 at y-1; frame 3: x-1, y-3..y+3), whatever its target is. Each fire picture strikes 15 frames later: the enemy standing on that exact tile, if it is a unit, starts burning: 5 damage a tick, 5 ticks, a tick every 30 frames (1 s), through the normal damage. A unit already burning is not set burning again. Buildings on the row are untouched.
needs: towerRow: on each beat, instead of the shot, 7 tiles in a row parallel to the tower's facing side, 1 tile out, offsets -3..+3 along it (by rotation 0..3 as in notes); 15 frames later each enemy unit on those tiles starts burning 5 per 30 frames for 5 ticks unless already burning.

beats.name: Phoenix Blue Egg
beats.notes: An egg (life 250), on PhoenixEggDelegate with the Blue Phoenix 775 as its bird. 5 s (150 frames) after it appears, if it is still alive, the Blue Phoenix hatches on its tile on the egg's side, with a quarter of its life, fading in over 1 s; that phoenix will not lay another egg when it dies. The egg then shows broken, can't be killed, and is removed 3 s (90 frames) later. If the egg is destroyed before hatching, it is removed at once and the Blue Phoenix goes to the graveyard (the client sends the graveyard command for 775).
needs: hatch: egg 1282 hatches unit 775 on its tile, same side, life = 775's life / 4, 150 frames after it is laid if still alive; the hatched bird can't lay again; the egg becomes unkillable and vanishes 90 frames later. Killed first: remove the egg and send the phoenix to the graveyard (server command as the Flash client sends).

beats.name: Water Tower
beats.notes: A tower. Every beat (interval 40 frames) no shot; a wave rolls out from the side it faces (by rotation: frame 0 toward +y, 1 toward +x, 2 toward -y, 3 toward -x), 5 tiles wide (-2..+2 across) and 7 rows deep (rows 1..7 out). The first row comes 15 frames (0.5 s) after the beat, then a row every 15 frames (7 rows, last at 105 frames). Each tile is struck at once: the enemy on it, if a unit, is thrown 5 tiles away from the tower and takes the tower's own attack from its config (3; not boosted), through the normal damage. Buildings untouched. Waves can overlap since a wave lasts longer than a beat.
needs: towerWave: on each beat, instead of the shot, rows 1..7 out on the tower's facing side, 5 tiles wide, one row every 15 frames starting 15 frames after the beat; each enemy unit on a struck tile is thrown 5 tiles from the tower and hurt by the tower's config attack.

beats.name: Infernal Kamikaze
beats.notes: Every beat it blows up instead of hitting, with the same blow-up as the troll kamikaze 575 (already in battle.ts): 500 to itself, and 500 to each thing on the 5 x 5 tiles round it (units on the four diagonal-ish tiles where both offsets are non-zero are also thrown 4). Only kamikazes of id 575 caught in it go off too; another 686 nearby just takes the 500. It names a training building (1211) that nothing reads.
needs: Treat 686 as a kamikaze in battle.ts: on its beat call the existing blow-up (500 to self and to everything in the 5 x 5 square, throw 4 for tiles off both axes); chain only to 575, not to 686.

beats.name: Rhino Rider (Infernal) and Necro Rhino
beats.notes: Same as RinoceronteDelegate (see there): every tile it walks onto, the nearest enemy within 1 tile straight-line (its own tile or the 4 beside it) is thrown 5 tiles without harm if it is a unit of under 4 population. It also names a training building (1212) that nothing reads. Its plain hits are ordinary.
needs: onEnterTile push: as RinoceronteDelegate.

beats.name: Rhino Rider (troll and human)
beats.notes: No beat moves; plain hits. Each time it enters a tile while walking, it looks for the nearest enemy element within straight-line distance 1 (d^2 <= 1: its own tile or the 4 orthogonal ones; unarmed things sort after armed ones). If that is a unit of population under 4 it is thrown 5 tiles away from the rhino, no damage (the usual throw rules: not giants, bosses, enlarged or helpless units). If the nearest is a building, nothing. One unit at most per tile entered. A random test meant to make it occasional can never fail, so it is every tile.
needs: onEnterTile push: when this unit steps onto a tile, the nearest enemy (unit or building) with dx^2+dy^2 <= 1; if a unit with population < 4, knock it 5 tiles from the rhino, no damage.

beats.name: Dragon Rider I to III
beats.notes: Four plain beats, then the 5th is a sweep instead of the hit, at once on the beat: every enemy within 2 tiles straight-line (d^2 <= 4), at most 20, nearest first, not on its own tile, takes half its attack; units among them are thrown 3. The original's pick is any enemy element: buildings and unarmed units (villagers) are hit too, which our blast's fighting-units-only filter leaves out. If it had no target, the first thing hit becomes its target. The special animation plays to its end; it is not helpless.
needs: blast option to pick any enemy element (buildings and unarmed units too), not only fighting units, and to leave out its own tile.

beats.name: Dark Punky Draggy
beats.notes: Shoots fireballs (projectile 9) with a 10-frame delay. Each beat, a draw: 1 time in 5 (random 0..10 above 8) it also calls a rain of 10 meteors; the plain fireball still flies. Each meteor falls 20 to 30 frames later on a tile picked in the SQUARE of 2 tiles each way round its target (each axis rounded from a uniform spread, so the middle tiles come up more often; a repeat of the very first tile isn't prevented), hitting the enemy on that tile (unit or building) for its full attack. The special animation is held 2 s. Not 'every 10 beats': a fresh 20% draw on every beat.

beats.name: Atlas Titan
beats.notes: Near = target within 2 tiles each way (the larger of dx, dy, between footprints). It keeps TWO counters, one for near beats and one for far beats; each special is the 5th, 15th, 25th... beat of its own kind (every 10, at 5), not every 5th. Plain beats (both near and far): a catapult fireball (projectile 100) shot 15 frames after the beat, if it is still in its plain attack pose. Near special (animation 7, helpless): six bursts at frames 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80: each, the fighting units within 8 tiles straight-line (at most 10, own tile included) take its attack and are thrown 5. Far special (animation 6, helpless): at frame 31 it throws a planet (projectile 129) at its target; where it lands, fighting units within 2 tiles (at most 5) take 1.5 x attack and are thrown 8. Add the planet's flight time to the 30 frames (not in the code; a projectile). Only units that can be thrown are hurt by either. When it dies, 69 frames later one more burst like a near one (radius 8, at most 10, its attack, thrown 5).
needs: Separate beat counters for near and far beats (counts 'split'): each rule counts only beats of its own 'when'.
onDeath: 69 frames after it dies, fighting enemy units within 8 tiles (max 10) take its attack and are thrown 5.

beats.name: Tiny Fire God
beats.notes: One counter over all beats, a 31-beat cycle (beats 7, 13, 19, 25, 31; the map's 6th/12th... is one off). Its plain hit lands straight on its target at any distance, no shot. Beat 7, slash (animation 6, helpless): at frame 40 it strikes along its own tile and the 6 tiles ahead in the way it FACES (8 facings folded to 4 axis ways), and round EACH of those 7 points every fighting enemy unit within 4 tiles (at most 10 per point) gets its attack, a small hop (no move) and burning 5 a second for 8 s. A unit near several points is hit once per point. Burning doesn't restack on a unit already burning. Original slip: facing 'down' the line is its own tile and then the tile below six times. Beat 13, giant fireball (animation 7, helpless): shot at frame 61 (projectile 121); where it lands, fighting units within 5 (at most 10) take 3 x attack, thrown 8; add the flight time. Beat 19, whirlwind (animation 8, NOT helpless, but busy 5 s = 150 frames): hits at frames 12 and 17 of EACH loop of its clip: fighting units within 5 (at most 5), its attack, thrown 5. The 'every 15' here is a stand-in: the true spacing is 5 then (clip length - 5) frames, and the clip length isn't in the code. Beat 25: three Vulcano Minions 2076 next to it, each thrown 3 tiles out, only if it has at most 3 alive (all three or none); otherwise nothing at all that beat. Beat 31 'limit' (animation 10, helpless): 17 pulses at frames 35, 40 ... 115: fighting units within 5 (at most 10) take its attack and start burning 5 a second for 8 s (not if already burning); no throw. Built on LimitDelegate but has no LIMIT bar or buttons.
needs: Whirl with burning: the beat-31 pulses set each unit hit burning 5 per 30 frames for 8 ticks (unless already burning).
Spawn all-or-nothing: spawn the 3 minions only when alive minions + 3 <= 6; otherwise nothing.
Whirlwind tick spacing: frames 12 and 17 of each loop of 2153's animation 8 clip; read the clip length from the sprite sheet.
Slash direction: axis-aligned by facing, not toward the target (ghosts 'ahead' can go diagonal).

beats.name: Tiny Water God
beats.notes: Same 31-beat cycle as the Tiny Fire God; plain hit straight on the target at any distance. Beat 7, ground smash (animation 7, helpless): at frame 23 the same 7-point facing line as the fire god's slash (same 'down' slip), round each point fighting units within 4 (at most 10 per point) take its attack and are thrown 7 (hit again for each point they are near). Beat 13 (animation 8, helpless): picks fighting enemy units within 2 tiles (own tile included, nearest first) with max life 500 or less, up to 3 in a list it never empties; at frames 24, 32, 40 it grabs the 1st, 2nd, 3rd: each becomes helpless and its picture goes into the god's hand. The step that should kill them at the end is never called in this class (the Water God's own class does call it), so they are NOT killed: they stay helpless and unseen, but alive and hittable, for the rest of the battle. Since the list is never cleared, a god grabs at most 3 units in a whole battle. If the list is empty on that beat, nothing happens at all (no hit). Beat 19, whirlwind (animation 6, not helpless, busy 5 s): at frame 16 of each loop, fighting units within its reach + 1 = 4 (at most 10) take half its attack, thrown 6; 'every 30' is a stand-in for the clip length. Beat 25: three Water Minions 2084 (all or none, only with at most 3 alive), thrown 3 out. Beat 31 (animation 9, helpless): 20 pulses at frames 35, 40 ... 130: fighting units within 7 (at most 10) take 1.5 x attack and are thrown 8. The map's 'killing them' is wrong.
needs: Grab for good: at frames 24, 32, 40 of the move, the 1st/2nd/3rd unit of a per-god list (fighting enemy units within 2 tiles, nearest first, max life <= 500, list filled up to 3 total for the whole battle and never emptied) becomes helpless and hidden forever but stays alive and can be killed. Judgment call for the owner: the original never kills them (a slip); copying it leaves invisible frozen units on the field.
Spawn all-or-nothing as for the Tiny Fire God.
Whirlwind tick spacing: frame 16 of each loop of 2155's animation 6 clip; clip length from the sprite sheet.
Smash direction: axis-aligned by facing.

beats.name: Hidros Titan
beats.notes: Near = within 1 tile each way: a plain hit straight on the target, not counted. Within its reach (2..7) the beats are counted from 1: beat 1 and every 5th after (1, 6, 11...): six water balls (projectile 54) from alternate hands, each a full hit, shot at frames 2 and 8 of each loop of animation 7 until a once-a-second check sees 6 or more (so 6, sometimes a couple more); the 'every 6' spacing is a stand-in (6 then clip length - 6). Else beats 9, 17, 25, 33, 49... (every 8th from 1, not taken by the balls): if no whirlpools are out, at frame 13 of animation 8, 3 Whirlpools 728 (not four) on random free tiles near it, drawn half size, ALWAYS on the player's side even for an enemy titan, gone after 20 s; while they are out that beat is a beam instead. Every other far beat: a freezing beam (projectile 35, shot 35 frames after the beat, lasting 1 s); the target, if a unit and not already frozen, is helpless for 5 s and takes half its attack each second (5 times); the beam's own hit lands when it ends. If it is walking on a beam beat it does nothing and the beat is not counted. The animation-8 clip ends when a once-a-second check finds it on its last frame; if the clip loops before then, frame 13 could come again and spawn more (unclear without the clip).
needs: Timed summon on the player's side: 3 x 728, side always the player's, removed (faded) after 600 frames; while they exist, the hurricane rule is skipped and the beat falls to the next rule (the beam).

beats.name: Lythos Titan
beats.notes: One roll per beat, a whole number 0..9 rounded from a uniform spread: 1, 2 and 3 each come 1 time in 9 (not 1 in 10); otherwise a plain hit by hand (reach 3, no boulder shot). The three chances share ONE roll (1/9 each, 2/3 plain). While a move is under way no roll is made and beats are plain hits. 1: boulder rain (animation 6) at frame 20: 25 boulders on tiles in the square of 3 each way round its target, each 20 to 23 frames later, hitting the enemy on that tile (unit or building) for 10 x its attack each (the code really passes 10). 2: whirlwind (animation 7, held 4 s): once a second for 4 s, every enemy unit within 2 tiles (any unit, villagers too, not on its own tile; at most 20) is thrown 3 and takes attack / 2.2. 3 (animation 8) at frame 42: 3 Lythos Minions 763 on random free tiles near a point 2 tiles to its side, a third size, ALWAYS on the player's side, attacking its target; removed 5 s later (fade 1 s). Slip: if roll 3 comes again while minions are still out, nothing spawns and it never rolls again that battle (plain hits only).
needs: One shared roll for the three rules (1/9 each), not independent draws.

Timed summon on the player's side: 3 x 763, always the player's side, removed after 150 frames; if called while they are out, nothing spawns and the unit makes no more specials for the rest of the battle (original slip; judgment call whether to copy).

beats.name: Pyros Titan
beats.notes: Near = within 2 tiles each way. Its near-beat count never starts over, so each near special comes ONCE per titan per battle (every 1000000 stands for 'once'); other near beats are plain hits by hand. Near beat 4, stomp (animation 6): at frame 20, every enemy unit (any unit, villagers too) within 10 tiles straight-line, at most 10, takes half its attack, thrown 4. Near beat 8, magma (animation 8, at once): enemy units within 3 of its target (at most 10) start burning 6 a tick for 6 ticks with ticks 30 ms apart (the code uses ms, so it is about 36 damage in a fifth of a second), not if already burning: hence the whirl of 6 points for 6 frames. Near beat 12, explosion (animation 8): 16 frames later, each tile of the 5 x 5 square round itself: the enemy on that tile (unit or building) takes 1.5 x attack; units also burn 0.2 x attack a second for 5 s (9.4 for attack 47; scale with its attack) and are thrown 4. Far beats (3..6 tiles), never counted: two giant fire shots (projectile 23) at frames 18 and 29, each a full hit. When it dies it stomps once more (attack / 2 to up to 10 units within 10, thrown 4) and sets them burning 3 a tick for 3 ticks, 30 ms apart.
needs: onDeath: enemy units within 10 tiles (max 10) take attack / 2, are thrown 4 and take 3 more points 3 times (burn ticks 30 ms apart, not if already burning).
Burn damage tied to attack (0.2 x attack per tick) in ghosts' burn, and ghosts hitting buildings on the tile too (the explosion hits buildings for 1.5 x).

beats.name: Stratos Titan
beats.notes: Every beat is counted (near and far). Near = within 2 tiles each way. Near: every 12th beat it swallows up to 2 swallowable enemy units within its reach (7 tiles straight-line, nearest first): units, not bosses, not helpless, that had under 500 life when they appeared. They become helpless and unseen at once and die (killed by it) at frame 35. If there are none it makes a plain hit instead. Other near beats: plain hit by hand. Far (3..7): every 4th beat, if no tornado time is left, at frame 11 one Tornado 617 on a random free tile near it, ALWAYS on the player's side, lasting 10 s (then fades; also fades when the titan dies). Otherwise far beats are a swallow (as above); with nobody to swallow it plays the move and does nothing - it never hurts anything from afar.
needs: Swallow fallback: on the near 12th beat, if no unit qualifies, a plain hit instead.

Timed summon on the player's side: 617, side always the player's, removed after 300 frames or when the titan dies; the rule is blocked while that 10 s runs (even if the tornado died sooner), and the beat falls to the far swallow.
Swallow's life test is the unit's life when it appeared (< 500), and the grabbed units are helpless from the beat until they die 34 frames later.

beats.name: Mad Balrog
beats.notes: Every plain hit lands straight on its target at any distance (no shot). Near = within 2 tiles each way; only near beats are counted, in a 13-beat cycle (the map's every 6th/12th is one off): near beat 7, 20, 33... a smash (animation 6, helpless): at frame 22, fighting enemy units within 2 tiles straight-line (at most 10, not its own tile) take its attack and are thrown 4. Near beat 13, 26... a fire-meteor rain (animation 7, helpless): at frame 16, one meteor on every tile of the 7 x 7 square round its target (49), each 7 to 47 frames later, hitting the enemy on that tile (unit or building) for its attack. When it dies it smashes once more (as above, at once).
needs: onDeath: at once, fighting enemy units within 2 tiles (max 10, not its own tile) take its attack and are thrown 4.

beats.name: Cerberus
beats.notes: Near = target within 2 tiles each way (the largest of the x and y gaps, over both footprints). Only near beats advance its counter, which is tested before it goes up, so the 1st, 6th, 11th... near beat is the stomp: at frame 16 of its animation (33 frames long) every enemy unit within 5 tiles (circle, at most 20, nearest first) is thrown 3 tiles and takes attack / 2.2; it is busy 16 frames after that. Every other near beat is three bites (needs[0]); every beat from afar is three fireballs (needs[1]). It never makes a plain hit. Drawn 1.6 times bigger. The original's stomp picks any enemy unit (villagers and unarmed ones too); our blast picks fighting units only. Rules with kind 'other' stand in for the needs entries: until those are built, they make it do nothing on those beats.
needs: Bites (every near beat that isn't the stomp): no special animation; three bites at 8, 16 and 25 frames after the beat, busy until 34. Each does its full attack. The first goes to its target. The second and third each go to the nearest enemy unit within 2 tiles (circle, units only, the nearest 10 looked at) other than the one it bit last, or the same one again if there's no other; that unit becomes its target. If there's nobody, that bite is skipped.

Spread fireballs (every beat from afar, within its reach of 7): if its target is a helpless unit it first switches to the nearest enemy in reach that isn't helpless, and skips the beat if there is none. Animation 7 (26 frames). At 13 frames, three fireballs (projectile 9) in the same instant, each its full attack: the first at its target, the second and third each at the nearest enemy unit in reach (circle 7, units only) other than the one just shot at, which becomes its target (falls back to the same one if alone). Far beats don't count toward the stomp.

beats.name: Cyclops
beats.notes: No counter: one random roll per near beat (target within 1 tile each way): 4 in 10 a spin (rule 1), else 6 in 10 a hit by hand at full attack (rule 2) - the two chances are shares of the same roll. The spin is the engine's shared whirlwind: at frame 9 every enemy unit within 3 tiles (circle, at most 20) is thrown 1 tile and takes 0.45 x attack; busy until frame 26. From afar (2 to 6 tiles) its plain eye laser (projectile 44, a 0.7 s beam) 5 frames after the beat, busy 700 ms (21 frames); rule 3 only gives the laser its own animation and timing. Out of reach it walks closer. Its sheet has no animation 8 (the 26-frame clip sits at 7): check which picture the spin should show.

beats.name: Giant Cyclops
beats.notes: Every beat in reach (2) counts, near or far. Near = within 1 tile each way. Near beats: a slap at frame 5 of its normal attack animation (full attack, target thrown 2 tiles); once 8 or more beats have been counted, the next near beat is the grab instead (needs[0]): animation 6 (35 frames), at frame 5 it takes the nearest enemy unit within 2 tiles (circle) whose item life is 350 or less, not helpless and not a boss (not necessarily its target), holds it, and eats it at frame 16 (it dies). If nobody fits, the beat is lost but the counter still restarts. Far beats (2 tiles): its plain laser (projectile 44, 0.7 s beam) after 8 frames with animation 7 (20 frames). Slip in the original: the slap treats its target as a unit, so against a building up close it errors out and does no damage.
needs: Sticky counter: the grab fires on the first near beat once the counter has reached 8 or more (the counter only restarts, at 0, when the grab fires), not only when the 8th beat happens to be near.

beats.name: Sphinx
beats.notes: Its test 'within 2 tiles' equals its reach, so every beat counts. The counter runs in a cycle of 9: the 5th beat a sonic boom (animation 7, 26 frames; at frame 18 its target takes its full attack and a unit is thrown 3 tiles), the 9th a tail strike (animation 6, 39 frames; at frame 21 full attack, and a unit is poisoned for attack / 2 = 23 a tick (attack 46), 5 ticks, a tick every 3 s). Both leave it helpless while they play. Other beats: a plain hit by hand. The map's 'every 4th / every 8th' is off by one: 5th and 9th of every 9.

beats.name: Harpy
beats.notes: Every beat counts. Far = 3 tiles or more each way: a fireball (projectile 9, full attack) at frame 9 of animation 6 (18 frames). Near: a plain hit by hand, except the 8th, 16th... beat when near, which is the grab: the nearest enemy unit within 6 tiles (its reach minus 1, circle, not its own tile) whose item life is 350 or less, not helpless and not a boss. The victim is carried, helpless and hidden, and dies at frame 67 of animation 7 (67 frames); the harpy is helpless meanwhile. Our swallow takes it out at once, which matches the victim being out of the fight from the start. If the 8th beat is far it is a fireball and the grab waits for the 16th.
needs: Fallback: if no unit fits the grab, that beat is a plain hit (by hand) instead.

beats.name: Hercules
beats.notes: Every beat counts. 5th, 15th, 25th...: a smash at frame 20 of animation 7 (36 frames): the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 4 tiles (circle, not its own tile) take 1.5 x attack and are thrown 4. 10th, 20th...: a grab of the nearest enemy unit within its reach of 2 (circle) with item life 350 or less, not helpless, not a boss; it is held hidden and dies at the last frame of animation 6 (43 frames); Hercules is helpless meanwhile. Other beats: a plain hit by hand.
needs: Fallback: if no unit fits the grab, that beat is a plain hit (by hand) instead.

beats.name: Medusa
beats.notes: No counter: one random roll per beat, the chances are shares of it. Near (within 1 tile each way): 4 in 10 a tail sweep (the shared whirlwind at frame 16 of animation 8, 26 frames: enemy units within 3, at most 20, 0.45 x attack, thrown 1), else a hit by hand at full attack. Far (2 to 9 tiles): half the time the stone gaze, the other half a snake shot (projectile 45, full attack) 16 frames after the beat, busy 700 ms. Stone gaze: animation 6 (15 frames), a beam (projectile 46, 0.6 s) after 11 frames; as the beam starts the target turns to stone, helpless and still for 3 s (90 frames); the beam then does its full attack. The original's stone has no boss check and looks grey, not frozen.
needs: Condition: the stone gaze is only drawn when its target isn't already stone (stoned units are remembered by every Medusa); a stoned target always gets the snake shot.

beats.name: Minotaur
beats.notes: Every 4th beat a horn toss: animation 6 (21 frames); at frame 8 its target is thrown 5 tiles and takes no damage at all. Other beats a plain hit by hand.
needs: Fallback: when its target on the 4th beat is not a unit (a building), the counter still restarts but that beat is a plain hit.

beats.name: Blue Phoenix
beats.notes: Every beat counts; every 8th is the volley (needs[0]). Every shot that lands on a unit sets it burning for a third of its attack at that moment (48 / 3 = 16 a tick, 5 ticks, one a second); a unit already burning isn't set burning again. During the volley its attack is a third, so those shots burn for 16 / 3 = 5 a tick. No heal (unlike the Phoenix). Drawn 1.5 times bigger. Rules with kind 'other' stand in for the needs entries.
needs: Multi-target volley: its attack is a third (48 -> 16) while it lasts. Animation 6. At frame 5, then every 400 ms (12 frames), 10 rounds in all: each round one shot (projectile 56) at each of the 5 nearest enemy units within its reach of 9 (circle, units only), each its (third) attack. It stops early when a round finds nobody. Busy until 12 frames after the last round.
On death (once): at frame 35 of its death animation it leaves the field, and 200 ms later a Blue Phoenix Egg (1282) appears on the nearest free tile (see PhoenixBlueEggDelegate for the hatching).

beats.name: The Phoenix
beats.notes: Every beat counts; the 5-rule is checked first (beat 55 is a volley). Volley: its attack is halved while it lasts; from frame 13 of animation 6, 10 shots (projectile 43) 400 ms (12 frames) apart, each at the nearest enemy unit in reach (not necessarily its target, units only); it ends early if there is none. Heal: from frame 4 of animation 7, 50 life to itself, then again each second, 5 times at most, stopping when it is full. Every shot that lands on a unit sets it burning for a third of its attack then: 47 / 3 = 15 a tick (fractions dropped), 5 ticks a second apart, not stacking; volley shots burn for 23 / 3 = 7. Drawn 1.5 times bigger. Its death drops no egg. Slip in the original: the volley looks for units on the computer's side whoever owns the phoenix, so a phoenix defending a town shoots its own side.

beats.name: Green Phoenix
beats.notes: Every beat counts; every 11th is a whirlwind that starts at once (no frame wait): 5 sweeps 400 ms (12 frames) apart, done at 60 frames. Each sweep looks at each tile of the 5 x 5 square round it (radius 2.83 in our circle covers exactly that square) and hits the one enemy standing there with attack / 1.4, throwing units 3 tiles. Plain shots (projectile 85) burn the unit hit for 50 / 3 = 16 a tick, 5 ticks a second apart. No volley, no heal. Drawn 1.5 times bigger.
needs: The sweeps hit buildings too: any enemy target whose anchor tile is in the square (our whirl picks fighting units only).

On death (once), instead of an egg: at frame 35 of its death animation, everything enemy on the 5 x 5 square round it takes 2 x its attack, units are thrown 6 tiles and glow yellow for 4 s (only a look).

beats.name: Horus Herald
beats.notes: Every beat counts (cycle of 5). On the 5th, if its target is within 2 tiles each way: a spin, helpless for 2 s (60 frames) in animation 6 (31 frames, looping); each time the clip passes frame 22 (at 22 and 53) the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 2 tiles (circle, not its own tile) take its full attack and are thrown 4. Otherwise (and on the 5th beat from afar) a spear (projectile 87) thrown 250 ms (about 8 frames) after the swing: its plain shot.

beats.name: Horus Gryphon
beats.notes: Every beat counts (cycle of 8). The 4th of each 8, if its target is within 2 tiles each way: a smash at frame 50 of animation 7 (80 frames), helpless: the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 (circle, not its own tile) take its full attack and are thrown 3. The 8th of each 8, if its target is farther: it takes off, helpless, for 6 s in animation 6 (50 frames, looping); each pass of frame 30 (at 30, 80, 130, maybe 180 as it lands) it picks the nearest enemy afresh as its target and throws an energy ball (projectile 70) at it, full attack, if within reach 8. Then it lands (frames 37 to 50, about 13 more frames). All other beats, and those two when the distance is wrong: a spear (projectile 87) 250 ms after the swing, its plain shot. Our volley keeps the same target while it lives instead of choosing afresh.

beats.name: Ramses II
beats.notes: Every beat counts. 8th, 16th...: a blade sweep at frame 11 of animation 7 (23 frames): the 10 nearest enemies within 3 tiles (circle, not its own tile) take its full attack, units thrown 2. 4th, 12th, 20th...: a blade blow at frame 9 of animation 6 (19 frames): its target takes 2 x attack. Other beats a plain hit by hand (reach 2).
needs: The sweep hits buildings too (any valid enemy target whose anchor tile is within 3 tiles), not only fighting units; buildings are not thrown.

beats.name: Tuthankamon
beats.notes: Two counters: near beats (within 2 tiles each way) count only toward the ring, far beats only toward the balls (each rule's 'counts'). Every 5th near beat a ring of fire, helpless, animation 6 (90 frames): at frames 55, 60, 65 and 70 the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 2 (circle, not its own tile) take half its attack, are thrown 4 and, once landed, burn for a fixed 5 a tick, 5 ticks a second apart. Thrown units stay on their old tile and count as helpless while in the air (1 s), and the original stops a ring at the first helpless unit it meets, so in practice only the first ring lands on ordinary units: hence repeat 1. A unit that can't be thrown (boss, giant, grown) is hit by all four rings, and the original errors out right after hurting it, so units after it in that ring are spared. Every 6th far beat, helpless in animation 7 (52 frames, looping): from frame 41, an energy ball (projectile 70) every 200 ms for 3 s at its target if within reach 6, each doing half its attack if it lands (14 by the timer; 12 to 15 on a real Flash player). Other beats: its plain electric beam (projectile 24) 13 frames after the swing, up close too.
needs: Split counters: separate near and far beat counters (the 'counts' given per rule).

beats.name: Predator Lizard
beats.notes: Two counters, near (within 2 tiles each way) and far, each a cycle of 5. 5th far beat: if its target is a living unit in reach (9) whose maximum life is 500 or less (no boss check), the tongue: helpless, animation 7 (113 frames); at frame 10 a tongue (projectile 136, no damage) flies out, grabs the target at the tongue's frame 14 (about 23 frames after the beat), and the target dies when the animation ends (about 4.5 s later, held helpless till then). 5th near beat: a smash, helpless, animation 6 (69 frames); at frame 35 the 5 nearest fighting enemy units within 5 tiles (circle, its own tile included) each take its full attack and are thrown 5 - but a unit that can't be thrown right then (already in the air) takes nothing. Every other beat: an acid spit (its plain shot) 15 frames after the swing.
needs: Split counters: separate near and far beat counters (the 'counts' given per rule).
Fallback: when the 5th far beat's target can't be eaten (not a unit, out of reach, or maximum life over 500), that beat is a plain spit instead (the counter still moves on).

beats.name: Burning Tiger
beats.notes: Every beat counts (cycle of 10). Plain beats: full attack by hand, and a unit hit is always thrown 1 tile. 5th of each 10: helpless for 5 s in animation 6 (40 frames, looping); each pass of frame 23 (at 23, 63, 103, 143) a fireball (projectile 100) at its target if alive and within its reach of 2, full attack; then it plays frames 27 to 40 and picks a new target. 10th of each 10: a smash, helpless, animation 7 (59 frames): at frames 40 and 45 the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 (circle, not its own tile) that aren't helpless take half its attack, are thrown 4, and burn for a fixed 5 a tick, 5 ticks a second apart, starting after a 1 s flame. Thrown units are in the air at 45 and skipped, so repeat 1; units that can't be thrown (bosses, giants) take both hits.
needs: Burning fireballs: each fireball that hits a unit also sets it burning, 5 a tick, 5 ticks a second apart (our volley has no burn).

beats.name: Colossal Cobra
beats.notes: No beat counting. It is the Giant Viper's behaviour (SnakeDelegate): its eating is on a timer (every 360 frames, for 200), exactly like the Giant Viper's existing auto entry (ids 653, 668): add 709 there. On top, every spit (projectile 21, 6 frames after the swing) that lands on a unit poisons it for attack / 2 = 14 a tick (attack 28), 3 ticks, a tick every 3 s; not if already poisoned. The poison has no owner in the original (kills by it are nobody's).

beats.name: Cobra Rider
beats.notes: A 9-beat cycle, every beat counted (no distance test). Beat 5 of each 9: it eats its target if that is a unit, not a boss, not helpless, with item life 500 or less: grabbed at frame 10 of SPECIAL1 (a 63-frame clip, the Cobra helpless meanwhile), killed when the clip ends. If the target can't be eaten, beat 5 is a plain hit instead. Beat 9: a spin lasting 3 s (90 frames) in SPECIAL2, a 14-frame clip that loops; it strikes on frames 4, 8 and 12 of every loop, so 19 strikes in all (frames 3, 7, 11, 17, 21, 25 ... 87 after the beat), each at the fighting enemy units within 2 tiles (10 at most): half its attack (whole points), thrown 4, poisoned 5 every 3 s for 5 ticks (once). Plain beats are its own direct hit (hand to hand at reach 2).
needs: eatOrHit: on beat 5 of 9, if the target isn't eatable (not a unit, a boss, helpless, or item life over 500) do a plain hit instead of nothing.
busy: no beats while a special plays: 63 frames after the eat, 90 frames after the spin (the original returns early while busy and doesn't advance the count).

beats.name: Frankenstein
beats.notes: No beat counter. 'Near' is 1 tile each way (the larger of the x and y gaps, over both footprints). Up close: a direct hit (not a shot) with its attack, and half the time (one roll, 1 in 2) a knock-down (units under population 4, not bosses). From 2 tiles to its reach (7): a rain of screws in SPECIAL1: every 750 ms (22.5 frames; first one 750 ms after the beat), 6 times, 5 points (through the damage formula) to each of the 10 nearest enemies within reach + 2 = 9 tiles (a circle). The screw pictures are only for show (they do 0). The rule's two near entries are one roll: the first takes half, the second the rest.
needs: rainStops: the rain ends early when a later beat finds the target within 1 tile or beyond its reach (that beat then plays normally), when Frankenstein walks or dies, or when a tick finds no enemy within 9 tiles. No plain beats while it rains (up to 135 frames).
rainHitsBuildings: the screws pick any valid enemy target within 9 tiles, buildings included, not just fighting units as whirl does.

beats.name: Pumpkin Monster
beats.notes: Frankenstein's class exactly, with magma blobs instead of screws (for show only). Its reach is also 7, so the rain reaches 9 tiles. The rain still does a fixed 5 per tick despite its bigger attack.
needs: rainStops: as Frankenstein's.
rainHitsBuildings: as Frankenstein's.

beats.name: Godzilla
beats.notes: Never a plain hit. Within 2 tiles (each way) it counts its beats: the 8th, 16th... is a big stamp (frame 17 of SPECIAL1, a 35-frame clip): the 30 nearest enemy units within 10 tiles take whole-point 1.2 x attack and are thrown 6. Every other near beat is a small stamp in the normal attack animation (2, a 50-frame clip), at frame 17: the 10 nearest within 3 tiles take half its attack (whole points) and are thrown 2. The code means the small stamp's throw to be 1 in 10 but a slip makes it always happen. Beyond 2 tiles, within its reach (5): fire breath (SPECIAL2, a 64-frame clip) at frame 19. The stamps pick any enemy unit (villagers too), not only fighting ones.
needs: breath: starting on its own tile and stepping along its facing (straight grid directions 8 tiles, grid diagonals 5 tiles, own tile included), at each tile the enemy units within 1 tile (the tile and its 4 side neighbours, 30 at most) are collected; the lists are joined without removing repeats, so a unit beside the line can be hit 2 or 3 times. Each entry: its full attack, and set burning 8 a second for 3 seconds (not again if already burning).
busy: no beats until the clip ends: 50 frames for a small stamp (attack interval is 40), 35 for the big one, 64 for the breath. It also stops if it starts walking.

beats.name: Ice Golem
beats.notes: The counter starts at 0 and the class tests it before adding, so the cycle is 11 beats: the 6th is the freezing beam (frame 12 of SPECIAL1, a 68-frame clip, the golem helpless), the 11th the turning (frame 45 of SPECIAL2, 79 frames), the others its direct hit. The freeze rule above only covers the circle round its own tile; the needs entry is the real shape and replaces it once built.
needs: freezeLine: its own tile and the 3 tiles ahead along its facing; around each, the fighting enemy units within 3 tiles (10 at most per tile) are frozen: helpless 5 s (150 frames) in an ice block, taking 20 points (through the damage formula) every second, 5 times. Already frozen units aren't frozen again. Slip in the original: facing down, all 3 'ahead' tiles are the same tile, one step down.

convert: the 3 nearest fighting enemy units within 6 tiles are picked first, then those with max life 500 or less change to its side (same unit, same life, marked summoned). After 15 s those still alive switch sides again. If a second turning happens before the first 15 s are up, the first timer sends back both groups and the second does nothing.
busy: no beats for 68 frames after the beam, 79 after the turning.

beats.name: King Kong / Snowy Kong
beats.notes: No beat counter. Within 2 tiles each way: a direct hit for 1.5 x attack. From 3 tiles to its reach (7): a normal shot with a banana (projectile 37, 10 frames after the beat), thrown in SPECIAL1. Its two moves come on a clock instead, see needs; while one plays it doesn't attack at all.
needs: timed (fits our AutoEntry): a counter starts at -105 and goes up 1 every frame while it has a target (it starts ticking at its first beat). At 0, in turn: (a) grab: the 2 nearest enemy units within reach - 1 = 6 tiles with item life 350 or less, not bosses, not helpless; only if exactly 2 are found, SPECIAL3 (8, a 105-frame clip) and both die at frame 104; else nothing and the turn is spent. (b) heal: +100 life to itself at once, SPECIAL2 (7) for 75 frames. Kong is helpless during either; the counter goes back to -105 when it ends. As an AutoEntry: interval 105, animations [8, 7], lengths [105, 75], moves [swallow radius 6 max 2 maxLife 350 around self (needs 'exactly two'), heal who self amount 100 factor 0].

beats.name: Giant Mammoth
beats.notes: Never does plain damage. A 5-beat cycle of near beats (within 2 tiles each way; beyond that it does nothing): beat 3 a spin (frame 20 of SPECIAL1, 34 frames; it can't walk till the clip ends), beat 5 a charge, the others throw the target 5 tiles at frame 10 without hurting it. The spin hits the 5 x 5 square round it, one target per tile (radius 2.83 gives exactly that square in our circle test): 1.5 x attack, units thrown 4. Slip: the class has a 'busy' flag it never sets, so beats keep coming during the spin and charge.
needs: charge: speed doubled and a red glow; it runs 5 tiles along its facing (by facing 1..8: (0,-5), (+5,-5), (+5,-5), (+5,+5), (0,+5), (-5,-5), (-5,0), (-5,+5)), then back to where it started: one trip out and one back (not two). On every tile it enters, the nearest enemy (unit or building) within 1 tile; if a unit, it takes 1.5 x attack and is thrown 5. After 5 s it gives up: normal speed, no glow, no more hits.
squareHitsBuildings: the spin's square also hurts buildings whose reference tile is in it (one target per tile), and villagers; blast picks fighting units only.

beats.name: Metal T-Rex
beats.notes: Within 2 tiles each way: claws at frame 17 of the attack clip (its attack, thrown 1; skipped if the target has gone beyond 2 tiles), and every 4th near beat a claw smash in SPECIAL2: frames 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, each time the 8 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 tiles (not on its own tile) that can be thrown take half its attack and are thrown 6; ones that can't be thrown aren't hurt either. Beyond 2 tiles: a large fireball (projectile 113) at frame 15 of SPECIAL1, its attack.
needs: busy: no beats until the clip ends: 57 frames after the smash (attack interval 35); claws 25, fireball 34.

beats.name: Atomic Godzilla
beats.notes: The counter adds first and wraps from 13 to 0, so the cycle is 13 near beats (within 3 tiles each way; its reach is 2, so every beat): the 3rd a ground smash (frame 22 of SPECIAL1, 35 frames), the 6th a radiation burst (frame 30 of SPECIAL2, 105 frames), the rest its direct hit. Both hit the 5 x 5 square round it, one target per tile (radius 2.83 = that square): 1.25 x and 1.5 x attack, units thrown 4. The burst's yellow glow lasts 4 s and is only a look. It can't walk during either.
needs: deathBurst: when it dies, at frame 30 of its dying clip (68 frames), one more burst: the 5 x 5 square, 1.5 x attack, units thrown 6.
squareHitsBuildings: the square also hurts buildings and villagers (one target per tile), not only fighting units.
busy: no beats until the clip ends plus 250 ms (8 frames): 43 frames after the smash, 113 after the burst.

beats.name: Tiger Spider
beats.notes: Near = touching (1 tile each way). Its near count starts at 0 and is tested before adding, so the spin (SPECIAL3) is near beats 1, 6, 11...; the blow (SPECIAL1) is near beats 9, 17, 25, 33, 49... (the spin wins when both fall on one beat, as the rule order does). Each is three sweeps: the first at frame 19 (spin) or 13 (blow), then two more on a 1-second clock of its own (so the gaps are up to a second, not exactly 30 frames). A sweep: the 20 nearest enemy units within 3 tiles (villagers too), first freed if helpless, then thrown (3 spin / 1 blow) and hurt (whole-point attack / 2.2 spin, 1.3 x attack blow). Other near beats: its direct hit. From 3 tiles to its reach (7): a web beam (projectile 42, SPECIAL4 = 9, 16 frames, then 0.5 s of beam) that lands as a normal shot and then webs: held helpless and idle 120 frames, 1 point every 500 ms while webbed.
needs: approach: at exactly 2 tiles it doesn't attack but walks onto its target.
webRetarget: if its target is already helpless it first picks another not-helpless enemy within reach (none: no attack); after webbing, it drops its target so it picks another.
busy: no beats during the three sweeps (about 2-3 s) and until the web beam lands.

beats.name: Sword Lion Warrior
beats.notes: A 12-beat cycle: 6th beat four smashes (SPECIAL1, 101 frames; frames 27, 47, 68, 88): the 3 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take 2 x attack and are thrown 5. 12th beat a thunderbolt storm (SPECIAL2, 90 frames) at frame 20, but only if its target is within its reach (or it has none); if the target has gone out of reach there is no storm at all. Other beats: its direct hit. The map has the storm's condition the wrong way round.
needs: stormIfInReach: at frame 20 skip the storm when the target is beyond its reach.

aimedStorm: the storm centres on the target's tile; a bolt every 100 ms (3 frames) for 2 s, 20 bolts, each 0.5 x attack to whatever stands on its tile (buildings too). Odd bolts fall on a random tile of the 7 x 7 square round the centre; every other bolt (the 1st, 3rd...) instead switches the lion's own target to another enemy unit within its reach (not the last one picked) and falls on it.
busy: no beats for 101 frames after the smashes, 90 after the storm.

beats.name: Vulcano Golem
beats.notes: Plain beats (and every beat beyond 3 tiles) throw a fireball (projectile 100, its attack) 15 frames after the beat, only if it is still in its attack clip then. Near beats (within 3 tiles each way) count an 8-beat cycle: 4th four fist smashes (SPECIAL1, 34 frames; frames 15, 20, 25, 30): around the tile 2 ahead along its facing, the 5 nearest fighting enemy units within 2 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 3. 8th four bursts of flame (SPECIAL2, 52 frames; frames 15, 25, 35, 45): the 5 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 tiles of it, skipping any already burning or fireproof, take its attack and burn 5 a second for 5 s.
needs: skipBurning: each flame burst passes over units already burning, so a unit is hurt by one burst only and later bursts reach others; ghosts as written would hit the same units 4 times.
busy: no beats for 52 frames after the flames (attack interval 35).

beats.name: Black Witch
beats.notes: Plain beats: a lightning shot (projectile 8, 11 frames after the beat). Its move is on a clock, not a count: a 5 s timer starts at a beat when not running; once it has run out, the next beat is the frog spell instead of a shot. At attack interval 20 that's about every 9th beat.
needs: frog: SPECIAL1, an electricity beam (projectile 24, 8 frames after the beat, beam 1 s). As the beam starts, if the target is a unit and no frog of hers is active: the target leaves the fight for 120 frames (invisible, helpless, counted as dead so nobody targets it, on no side), then comes back on its own side with the life it had; that beam does no damage and the witch drops her target. Otherwise (a building, or a frog already out) the beam hits normally. After the spell the 5 s timer starts again at her next beat.

beats.name: Spectrum Dragon
beats.notes: The counter wraps from 4 back to 0, so the cycle is 4 beats and the special is the 3rd of each (beats 3, 7, 11...), not every 3rd. Special: SPECIAL2 (40 frames, helpless), seven small necro fireballs (projectile 80) at frames 16, 20 ... 40, each a full shot at its target. Plain beats: a necro beam (projectile 73, 13 frames after the beat, 1 s beam).
needs: raise (all necro units): when it kills a unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton rises on that tile on its side, picked at random from 808, 797, 818 (sword, axe, archer); summoned, it dies after 15 s.

beats.name: Necro Abomination
beats.notes: The count starts at 0 and skips 0, so the leap is beats 10, 19, 28... and the sword stroke beats 5, 9, 13... (the leap wins on beat 37). Beat 1 is plain, which every/at can't say (see needs). Sword (SPECIAL1, frame 20): the enemy units within 1 tile of its own tile, and within 1 tile of the next tile ahead, 30 at most each, lists joined with repeats (a unit near both is hit twice): thrown 3, 1.5 x attack. Leap (SPECIAL2, 36 frames, helpless; frame 21): the 20 nearest enemy units within 4 tiles, thrown 5, attack / 2.2. Both pick villagers too. Plain beats: its hit at frame 7 of the attack clip.
needs: notFirst: neither rule may fire on beat 1 (the class requires a count above 0).
raise: as DragonKingDelegate's (3 in 10 kills rise as a skeleton for 15 s).

beats.name: Necro Dark Lord
beats.notes: No counter: one roll per beat: under 0.5 a plain attack, 0.5 to 0.75 a blow (SPECIAL1, frame 9: target thrown 3 then its attack), above 0.75 a sweep (SPECIAL2, frame 11: the 20 nearest enemy units, villagers too, within its reach of 2 tiles, thrown 3, 0.45 x attack). The two chances are shares of that one roll: if our rules draw separately, the second needs 1/3. It attacks only when its target is within reach (each way). Its plain attack goes through the shared code: reach 2 and no hand-to-hand flag, so it is a shot.
needs: raise: as DragonKingDelegate's.

beats.name: Necro Ghost
beats.notes: Every 6th beat takes souls (SPECIAL1, 38 frames; frame 7): the 20 nearest fighting enemy units within 5 tiles (not on its own tile) take half its attack; those who survive are knocked down (population under 4, not bosses). Other beats: an electricity beam (projectile 24, 9 frames after the beat) that holds a unit target helpless for interval x 0.4 / 30 s x 1.2 = 0.56 s (17 frames), no extra damage; the beam is a normal shot otherwise. Our freeze stands in for that short hold (it isn't ice).
needs: raise: as DragonKingDelegate's.

beats.name: Necro Gryphon Knight
beats.notes: 12th beat a bubble (SPECIAL2): it stands helpless 3 s (90 frames); the bubble appears at frame 17 and bursts 16 frames later: the 10 nearest fighting enemy units within 2 tiles of the knight (not its own tile) take 1.5 x attack and are thrown 4. Other 4th beats: four energy balls (projectile 70, its attack each) in SPECIAL1 (50 frames), helpless until the 4th. Unclear: the class fires a ball each time the clip shows frame 27 and jumps to frame 37 after the 4th, so the clip must loop back to 27 on its own; 10 frames apart (27 to 36) is our guess. The empty-points ghosts move is only there to keep it helpless. Plain beats are hand to hand at reach 2.
needs: raise: as DragonKingDelegate's.

beats.name: Necro Harvester
beats.notes: Every beat counts. 8th, 16th...: green necro beam (projectile 73, one full hit) at its target, or with no target at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles; the unit hit also changes sides for 10 s (see needs). Other 4th beats: a blow at frame 7, 2 x attack to the target, thrown 2 (units only; a building just takes the damage). Otherwise a hand hit (reach 2, ranged-melee). It stands helpless from the beam's start until the beam ends.
needs: turn: the beam's target switches to the Harvester's side for 300 frames (10 s), then switches back. It happens when the beam is fired (frame 11), before the beam's damage lands. Skipped if the unit is already switched, or if it started the battle with 500 life or more (the original's canBeConverted). Buildings are not switched. The switched unit is tinted green.

skeletons (NecroDelegate): whenever it kills an enemy unit, by any means, 3 chances in 10 that a skeleton rises on the victim's tile on its side: Sword Skeleton 808, Axe Skeleton 797 or Skeleton Archer 818, one of the three at random. The skeleton is summoned and dies by itself after 450 frames (15 s).

beats.name: Necro King
beats.notes: No counter: ONE random number per beat decides. Roll 0.75 or more AND target 1 or 2 tiles away (tiles each way, max of dx and dy over both footprints; 0 excluded) -> lightning rain. Roll 0.50 to 0.74 (any distance) -> blow at frame 22: target thrown 3 (units) and takes its attack. Everything else, including rolls between 0.74 and 0.75 and far rolls of 0.75+, is a plain hand hit at frame 8 (reach 3). The two shares come from the same roll, so they never both fire. Rain: 30 bolts, half its attack each, on tiles picked around its target (or itself with no target); the bolt lands 7..47 frames after frame 11 of the animation plus 15 frames of the bolt's own animation, so 33..73 frames after the beat. The original picks each tile as target +/- round(random x 6) - 3 on each axis: a 7 x 7 square, not a circle, the edge rows half as likely; tiles may repeat (its de-duplication never takes effect). Each bolt hurts whatever enemy unit or building stands on its tile. The clip pauses 1.8 s at frame 11, so the rain animation lasts about 70 frames.
needs: skeletons (NecroDelegate): whenever it kills an enemy unit, by any means (the rain's bolts count), 3 chances in 10 that a skeleton rises on the victim's tile on its side: 808, 797 or 818 at random, summoned, gone after 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Multi-arms
beats.notes: The counter is tested before it goes up, so the whirlwind is beat 1, 8, 15... (n % 7 == 1). Whirlwind: five turns, the first on the beat, the next four on the ticks of a 1-second timer that runs all the time (so the second turn comes 0-1 s after the first). Each turn: every enemy UNIT within 2 tiles (its own tile included, nearest 20; any unit, villagers and unarmed ones too, not just fighters) is thrown 3 tiles, then takes attack / 2.2. Its reach is set to 10 during the whirl so it doesn't walk away. Plain beats: hand hit at frame 9 (reach 2).
needs: skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Paladin
beats.notes: 8th beat: whirlwind of 12 turns, one per loop of its special-2 animation (29 frames in our sheet), at frame 18 of each loop: the nearest 4 enemy fighting units within its reach (3 tiles) take its attack and are thrown 3. Beats during the whirl are skipped (not counted). 4th beat of each 8 (n % 8 == 4): heals itself 150 at once. Plain beats: hand hit, reach 3.
needs: skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Priest
beats.notes: Every beat counts; every 8th beat heals: from frame 19, three heals (the first at once, the next two on the ticks of an always-running 1-second timer, so 0-1 s and 1-2 s later) of 100 each to every unit of its side within 3 tiles, itself included, nearest 20, any unit (villagers too). Plain beats: target 1 tile away (tiles each way) -> hand hit at frame 8; 2 tiles or more -> necro beam (projectile 73), one full hit.
needs: plain beat split by distance: hand hit when the target is 1 tile away, necro beam (projectile 73, its attack) from 2 tiles on. Today it would shoot an arrow at every distance: only the picture and the hand hit up close differ.
skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Evil Scorpion
beats.notes: Only beats with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way) do anything; further off the beat does nothing and isn't counted. Its counter runs 0..6 (a 7-beat cycle): 4th near beat a sting, 7th a spin, the rest plain hand hits. Sting at frame 10: target takes its attack; a unit is also poisoned (half its attack = 24 per tick, 5 ticks, one tick every 3 s) and thrown 2. Spin: 9 s (a 1-second timer started on the beat; it stops on its 9th tick), and at frame 15 of each loop of the 22-frame animation every tile of the 5 x 5 square round it is checked: whatever enemy unit OR building stands on it takes its attack, units thrown 4. That is about 12 strikes. Radius 2.9 makes our circle the same 5 x 5 square. Its plain beats are skipped during the spin.
needs: the spin also hits enemy buildings and unarmed units/villagers in the square (our whirl takes only fighting units). Thrown units stay on their old tile in the original until they land 1 s later, so the next strike 22 frames on can hit them again.

plain hits on a building: the original casts its target to a unit and fails, so the Scorpion never damages buildings with plain beats and its counter does not move then (a slip in the original). Decide whether to copy it.
skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Shark Monster
beats.notes: 12th beats: a ray at frame 35 that poisons the nearest 20 enemy fighting units within 3 tiles (20 a tick, 2 ticks, 3 s apart; no damage at once). Other 4th beats: scissors at frame 11, the nearest 10 enemy fighting units within its reach (2 tiles) that are IN FRONT of it take its attack and are thrown 2. Plain: hand hit, reach 2.
needs: front only (scissors): keep only enemies in front of it. The original takes the 8-way screen direction from the shark to each enemy and drops the three directions opposite the way it faces, so 5 of 8 directions count (a little over a half-circle in front).
skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Winged Warrior
beats.notes: Every beat counts. 8th beats with the target within 4 tiles (tiles each way): a necro rain of 20 drops on a 11 x 11 square round the target. It does NO damage: in the original's particle setup the necro rain falls through into the next case and ends with no hit frame, so its drops never strike and never fade. The plain hit is lost that beat. Otherwise: target within 2 tiles -> hand hit; 3 or more -> two necro axes (projectile 67) at frame 15, see needs. fx 'necro_rain' = magic particle type 44.
needs: two shots at two targets (from 3 tiles on): one axe at its target, one at the nearest enemy (unit or building) within 4 tiles of the target, or the target again if there is none; each a full hit (projectile 67). Within 2 tiles a hand hit instead (no shot).
skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Necro Worm
beats.notes: Every beat counts. On a 6th beat with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way) it grabs the nearest enemy unit within its reach minus 1 (6 tiles, straight line) whose item life is 350 or less, not a boss and not already helpless; it holds it in its mouth and at frame 26 deals it 10 x its item life (kills it). If none qualifies, that beat is an ordinary spit instead. Plain beats: spit (projectile 76), 5 frames after the swing.
needs: fallback: when nothing can be swallowed, the original spits as usual that beat (our replace would lose the hit).
skeletons (NecroDelegate): on killing an enemy unit, 3 in 10 a skeleton (808, 797 or 818 at random) rises on the victim's tile, its side, summoned, 450 frames.

beats.name: Imperial Elf Axe
beats.notes: 8th beat: whirlwind of 12 turns, one per loop of its special animation at frame 10: the nearest 4 enemy fighting units within 3 tiles (fixed 3, though its reach is 2) take its attack and are thrown 3. Loop length 17 frames is from our sheet, which has no separate special-1 group (the clip seems to fall back on its last 17-frame group), so 'every' is uncertain.
