A thrown unit stays on its old tile until it lands 30 frames later, so the next turn 17 frames on can hit it again. Beats during the whirl are skipped. Plain: hand hit, reach 2.

beats.name: Elven Crossbow
beats.notes: Counter 1..6, so every 6th beat: a super bolt (projectile 104) at frame 10 at its target: the bolt's own hit (its attack) plus 4 x attack when it lands, 5 x in all; it is helpless during the animation. Every other beat: three bolts (projectile 103) at frame 10, 0, 3 and 6 frames apart, each a full hit; each picks a target (see needs). A shot is not fired if its target is beyond its reach (13).
needs: a different target per bolt: each bolt goes to the nearest enemy fighting unit within its reach not yet shot this beat; when all within reach have been shot it goes to the last one picked; with no fighting unit in reach (buildings only) all three go to its current target. The picked unit also becomes its target from then on (the original rewrites its target).

beats.name: Elven Eagle Rider
beats.notes: Plain beats (any distance): two golden lasers (projectile 31) at frame 10, each a full hit. The counter (1..12) moves only on beats with the target 1 tile away (tiles each way; 2 or more is 'far'). 6th near beat: grabs the nearest 2 enemy units within 2 tiles whose item life is 350 or less (no boss, not helpless) and kills them at the end of its ~110-frame animation; if none qualifies nothing at all happens that beat. 12th near beat: wing attack at frames 70, 75 and 80: each time the nearest 4 enemy fighting units within 2 tiles take 2 x attack and are thrown 4. Thrown units keep their old tile until they land, so the same 4 take all three: written as one blast of 6 x attack. Units that can't be thrown at that moment are skipped.

beats.name: Imperial Elf Gryphon
beats.notes: Counter 1..16 moves only with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way); a far beat does nothing. 8th: frozen rain at frame 18: one drop on each of the 25 tiles of the 5 x 5 square round its target (itself with no target), half its attack to whatever enemy stands there, landing 25..60 frames later (10..45 delay plus 15); 1.5 s after it, the nearest 10 enemy fighting units within 3 tiles of the gryphon are frozen 6 s (no damage). The special lasts 3 s, then the rest of the animation. 16th: crystal balls (projectile 60), one per loop of its 50-frame animation at frame 30, for 5 s: 3 balls, each a full hit at its target. Plain: hand hit, reach 2. It is helpless during both.

beats.name: Imperial Elf Knight
beats.notes: Shoots (projectile ELF_KNIGHT) at frame 10. Counter 1..8 moves only with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way). 4th near beat: horse kick at frame 17 on its target if it is a unit (buildings: nothing): current life 350 or less -> killed outright, else 350 damage; thrown 4 either way. 8th near beat: energy burst at frame 20: the nearest 10 enemy fighting units within its reach (7 tiles), not already helpless, are thrown 1 tile; no damage. Helpless during both.
needs: execute: the kick kills its target outright (no damage roll, no defence) when the target's CURRENT life is 350 or less; otherwise the 350-point hit as written.

beats.name: Elf Priest
beats.notes: Shoots fireballs (projectile 39) at frame 10, near or far. Its counter runs 0..8, a 9-beat cycle, and moves only with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way): near beat 5, 14, 23... the bubble; near beat 9, 18... the heal. Heal at frame 20: 150 to each of the nearest 5 fighting units of its side within its reach (8), not itself, hurt or not; if it has none there, that beat is a plain shot instead. A slip in the original: once it has converts, its filter meant to drop summoned units from the heal can drop extra ones (it removes at the same index once per convert). Helpless during both specials.
needs: convert for a while (bubble): at frame 20 a bubble appears (2 tiles right/down of it), and 16 frames later every enemy unit within 5 tiles (straight line), nearest first, with item life 350 or less, convertible (started under 500 life), not helpless, not a boss, up to 3 minus its converts still alive, is replaced by the same unit on the priest's side with the same current life, summoned. 15 s (450 frames) after the first convert of a round, each convert still alive is replaced again by the same unit on the ENEMY (computer) side with its life: right for a player's priest; for a computer priest the converts never go back (a slip). Its count of converts goes down only when one dies (returned ones count too, so it can drift).

beats.name: Reptile Knight
beats.notes: Spits napalm (projectile 10) at frame 13, near or far. Counter 1..8 moves only with the target within 2 tiles (tiles each way). 4th near beat: fire breath, checked at frames 15, 20, 25, 30, 35: the nearest 5 enemy fighting units within 4 tiles that are not helpless take half its attack, catch fire and are thrown 2; on landing they burn 5 a second for 5 s (1-s ticks). Thrown units are helpless in the air for 30 frames, so the later checks skip them: in practice one hit each, which is what 'ghosts' with one point on itself does. 8th near beat: at frame 8 its target (or, with none, the nearest enemy within 10) is grabbed if it is a unit of 500 item life or less, not a boss, not helpless; it dies at the end of the ~52-frame animation. If not, nothing happens that beat.

beats.name: Red Bull Rider
beats.notes: Counter 1..12 on every beat, no distance test. Plain beats: hand hit, its attack, and a unit target is thrown 2. 6th: grabs the nearest enemy unit within 2 tiles of 350 item life or less (no boss, not helpless) and kills it at the end of its ~100-frame animation; if none, nothing happens that beat. 12th: smash at frames 60, 65 and 70: each time the nearest 10 enemy fighting units within 2 tiles (that can be thrown) take a quarter of its attack and are thrown 3. Thrown units keep their old tile until they land, so the same ones take all three: written as one blast of 0.75. It picks a new target afterwards. Our table today lists 2019 with no moves.

beats.name: Black Lizard Rider
beats.notes: Every beat counts; the 12-test comes first, so beat 24 swallows. 12th: it takes the nearest enemy (unit or building) within its reach (3); only if that is a unit does the special play, and at frame 16 the unit dies (2 x its item life in damage) if its item life is 500 or less and it is no boss; a building or nothing: the beat is lost; a bigger unit: the animation plays for nothing. Ours picks the nearest qualifying unit instead (close enough). 8th: dizzy wave at frame 33: the nearest 10 enemy fighting units within 6 tiles (its own tile too) are thrown 5 tiles, no damage, then dizzy (see needs). Plain: hand hit, reach 3.
needs: dizzy: each unit thrown by the wave, on landing (1 s later), is helpless for 6 s (180 frames) with stars over its head, standing idle; a unit already dizzy is thrown but gets no new stars.

beats.name: Orc Battering Ram
beats.notes: One counter over all beats. On the 5th beat, only if its target is a building: special 1 (helpless), on frame 28 the building takes 3 x attack. Every other beat, and the 5th when the target is a unit, it does its own smash on frame 18 of the plain swing: a building target takes its attack (a plain hit); a unit target means up to 5 fighting units within 2 tiles of the target's tile (the target itself included if it is a fighting unit) take a quarter of its attack, each with a 50% chance of being thrown 3. Units already mid-hop are skipped. The 'thrown 8' smash on units exists in the class but is only reached if the target switches from a building to a unit between the beat and frame 28. The map is wrong there: the 5th beat against units is just the normal smash.
needs: Rule conditions on the target's kind ('if': targetBuilding / targetUnit) so the 5th beat is special only against buildings.
blast with a per-unit throw chance: each unit hit is thrown 3 tiles with probability 0.5 (one coin per unit), not always.

beats.name: Boar Axe Rider
beats.notes: Every 5th beat (one counter, all beats): special 1, helpless; on frame 20, up to 3 fighting units nearest the target's tile within 2 tiles (target included) take its attack and are thrown 2. Other beats are plain. It hits by hand at reach 2 (rangedMelee).

beats.name: Orc Dragon
beats.notes: Two counters: far beats (target more than 2 tiles away, measured as the larger of the x and y gaps between footprints) and near beats each count on their own; the 8th of each kind is special. Far: special 2 (not helpless) for 4 s (120 frames); on frames 12, 16, 20, 24 and 28 of every loop of that animation a light ball (projectile 25) flies at its target for 0.4 x attack (only if the ball lands on it). The loop's length is not in the code: the rule assumes 30 frames, so 4 loops and 20 balls. Near: special 1 (helpless); on frames 16, 20, 24, 28 up to 10 fighting units within 2 tiles of it (not on its own tile) take its attack and are thrown 2; units already helpless (thrown) are skipped, so each unit is usually hit once. Plain hits: a light beam (projectile 26), 13 frames after the swing, beam lasting 1 s.
needs: Split counters: near beats and far beats each advance their own counter ('counts' per rule).
The near smash must skip units that are already helpless (our blast would hit a just-thrown unit again on the next of the 4 frames).

beats.name: Dual Axe Orc
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 10. 5th beat: special 2 (helpless), frame 20: if the target is a unit with max life 500 or less it dies at once, otherwise it takes 3 x attack; either way it is thrown 4. A building target gets nothing on that beat. 10th beat: special 1 (helpless), six falling axes on frames 36, 40, 46, 52, 59, 65: each time up to 3 fighting units within 2 tiles of it (own tile included) take its attack and are thrown 5 (units mid-hop skipped). The rule uses a plain 3 x hit as a stand-in for the slash. 'Life' in the map means max life.
needs: execute: its target, if a unit (not a building) with max life <= 500, dies at once (credited to it); otherwise takes 3 x attack; then thrown 4. Nothing at all against a building.

beats.name: TNT Orc
beats.notes: Not beat-counted: every beat it lobs a barrel (projectile 114, speed 15) 12 frames after the swing instead of a plain hit. Where the barrel lands, the 2 fighting units nearest that tile within 2 tiles take its attack and are thrown 1; if the target is a building, the building also takes its attack. It never blows itself up. The map is wrong: at most 2 units, thrown only 1 tile.
needs: Barrel shot: the blast should land when the barrel arrives (flight time of projectile 114) at the tile it was aimed at, not 12 frames after the beat.
A building target takes its attack as well (our blast picks fighting units only).

beats.name: Priest Orc
beats.notes: Two counters. The heal counter advances on every beat; on its 6th, if the priest is below max life, special 1 (helpless) and on frame 20 it heals itself 4 x attack; that beat's energy ball never leaves. If it is at full life the beat is plain. The smash counter advances on near beats only (target within 2 tiles, larger of the x/y gaps); on its 5th, special 2 (helpless) and on frames 25, 30, 35 every fighting unit within 3 tiles (up to 10, not its own tile) that is not already shocked takes half its attack and is shocked. So each unit is normally hit once; later frames catch only newcomers (and units that can't be shocked, which take the half attack each time). If both fall on one beat the smash wins and the heal is lost. Plain hits: an energy ball 8 frames after the swing, near or far.
needs: shock: the unit is helpless and takes 5 points every second for up to 5 s; it ends early at the first tick when the priest is not in its plain attack animation (e.g. still in its special, walking or dead). One shock at a time per unit.
Rule condition 'if': selfHurt (heal only below max life; otherwise a plain beat).
Per-rule counters: the heal counts all beats, the smash near beats only.

beats.name: Big Basher Orc, Brutal Slasher, Evil Demons
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 16. 8th beat: special 1 (not helpless) for 6 s; on frame 30 of every loop up to 10 fighting units within 3 tiles (not its own tile, mid-hop ones skipped) take its attack and are thrown 3. Loop length is not in the code; the rule assumes 30 frames, which gives 5 or 6 hits in the 6 s. 16th beat: special 2 (helpless), frame 30: the target (building too) takes 3 x attack, and up to 5 fighting units within 2 tiles of the target's tile, leaving out what stands on that tile (the target), take half its attack and are thrown 3. The rule carries only the 3 x hit; the splash is in needs.
needs: Splash leaving out the target: up to 5 fighting units within 2 tiles of the target's tile, not the target itself, take 0.5 x attack and are thrown 3 (a blast option like skipCentre).

beats.name: Orc Spear Warrior
beats.notes: One counter over all beats, mod 9. Beats 3 and 6, when the target is a unit: special 1 (not helpless), the lance still flies (a poisoned-looking one, same damage), and on frame 19 the target is poisoned: its attack (38) every 3 s, 2 ticks. Beat 9, only when the target is adjacent (gap under 2 tiles): special 2 (not helpless), on frame 15 of each loop, 12 times: the 4 fighting units nearest it within its reach (8 tiles, own tile included) take its attack and are thrown 3 (no mid-hop check). Loop length assumed 30 frames (12 hits over 12 s). Beat 9 from afar is a plain lance. Plain hits: a lance (projectile 105) 12 frames after the swing. The 'if' on the poison rules only stops the special animation against buildings: the poison kind does nothing there anyway.

beats.name: Spider Orc Rider
beats.notes: Two counters: near beats (target within 2 tiles) and far beats. Near 6th: special 1 (helpless), frame 28: up to 5 fighting units within 4 tiles of it (own tile included) take its attack; those with max life 500 or less are webbed. Far 4th: special 2 (helpless), frame 17: a web shot (projectile 42) at the target; on arrival the target (building too) takes its attack and, if a unit of max life 500 or less, is webbed. Every other beat: two cannonballs (projectile 3) 30 frames after the swing, one from each side, each a full hit (only if it is still in its plain attack animation then). The last rule (every 1) stands for that plain beat.
needs: web: helpless 5 s, taking 5 points each second (5 ticks of 1 s, 25 in all), only units with max life <= 500; one at a time per unit. Applies to the near smash's victims and to the web shot's target.
Split counters: near and far beats each have their own counter.

beats.name: Turkish Axeman
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 8. 4th beat: special 1 (helpless), frame 19: target (building too) takes 1.5 x attack; a unit is thrown 4. 8th beat: special 2 (helpless), on frames 25, 30, 35, 40, 45: up to 10 fighting units within 2 tiles (not its own tile) take half its attack, are thrown 4 and set burning (5 points a second for 5 s, once). No mid-hop check, and in the original a thrown unit keeps its tile until it lands 1 s later, so a unit in the ring takes all five half-hits (2.5 x attack). Ours moves thrown units at once, so later rings may miss them.
needs: Burning on an area move: each unit hit is set burning for 5 points every 30 frames, 5 ticks, once (no stacking).
Thrown units should stay hittable on their old tile until they land (30 frames), as the ring hits them five times in the original.

beats.name: Turkish Swordsman
beats.notes: One counter, 0 to 10 (11 beats). 6th beat: special 1 (not helpless); on frame 59 a rain of 20 swords falls on random tiles within 5 of its target over the next second (they do no damage: a picture only), and 18 frames (0.6 s) later the 5 fighting units nearest it within 7 tiles take its attack once. 10th beat: special 2 (helpless), frame 23: it heals itself 500, even at full life. Plain beats: its own hit on frame 5 of the swing.

beats.name: 2-Head Orc
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 10. Both specials first switch to the nearest enemy as target. 5th: special 2 (helpless), fireballs (projectile 100) on frames 40, 51, 62, 73, each a full hit if the target is within reach. 10th: special 1 (helpless), frame 45: if the target is within reach, a ray (projectile 102) lasting 35 frames; when it ends the target takes 2 x attack from the class plus the ray's own plain hit (1 x), so 3 x in all. The map's '2 x' is short of that. Plain beats (by hand at reach 5): on frame 20 of the swing the target takes its attack and hops (looks only), and up to 2 other fighting units within 2 tiles of the target's tile (not on it) take a quarter of its attack and hop. The last rule stands for that plain beat without its splash.
needs: Splash leaving out the target on every plain hit: up to 2 fighting units within 2 tiles of the target's tile, not the target, take 0.25 x attack (no throw; a short hop that is only a picture).
Before each special, take the nearest enemy as the new target.

beats.name: Lion Soul Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 16. 8th: special 1 (helpless), frame 31: the spirit lion strikes its own tile and the 4 tiles ahead (the way it faces); around each of those 5 points, up to 10 fighting units within 4 tiles take 1.2 x attack, no throw. A unit near several points is struck once per point (up to 5 times). 16th: special 2 (helpless) for 3 s: 6 ticks, 500 ms apart, the first 16 frames after the beat: up to 6 fighting units within 8 tiles (own tile included, mid-hop ones skipped) take 1.4 x attack and are thrown 5. ghosts is used for the lion: it hits per point, as the original does.

beats.name: Blade Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 10. 5th: special 1 (helpless), frame 45: its own tile and 3 tiles ahead; around each point up to 10 fighting units within 2 tiles take 1.5 x attack and are thrown 5 (once per point). 10th: special 2 (helpless), frame 25: its target, if a unit not mid-hop: max life 500 or less, thrown 12 and killed when it lands; otherwise 1.5 x attack and thrown 5. A building target gets nothing. The rule uses the 1.5 x hit as a stand-in.
needs: fling-kill: the target unit, if its max life <= 500, is thrown 12 tiles and dies when it lands (about 30 frames later), credited to it; if it can't be thrown (helpless, giant, boss, enlarged) nothing happens. Otherwise 1.5 x attack, thrown 5. Nothing against a building.

beats.name: 4-Weapons Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 10. 5th: special 1 (helpless), frame 37: target unit with max life over 500 takes 2 x attack, thrown 2; one of 500 or less is thrown 10 and killed when it lands. A building target gets nothing. 10th: special 2 (helpless), frame 91: up to 10 fighting units within 6 tiles (own tile included, mid-hop skipped) take its attack and are thrown 10. The rule uses the 2 x hit as a stand-in for the smash. Its class sits in the buildings folder.
needs: fling-kill: target unit with max life <= 500 thrown 10 and dies on landing (credited to it); else 2 x attack, thrown 2. Nothing against a building. If the small unit can't be thrown the original errors out and nothing happens.

beats.name: Bull Gladiator
beats.notes: Two counters, each 0 to 6, so the 7th far beat and the 7th near beat (not every 6th as the map says). Near means the target within 2 tiles. Far 7th: if there is room to charge along the way it faces (it looks up to 9 tiles, its reach), it dashes there and back (0.5 s each way, a picture only; its tile doesn't change) and at once strikes its own tile and the 9 tiles ahead: around each point up to 10 fighting units within 5 tiles are struck, once per point, skipping units mid-hop. The first struck unit with max life under 500 is thrown 12 and dies on landing; until one is found, each struck unit takes a fixed 500 points (not its attack) and is thrown 5; after, its attack and thrown 5. No room to charge: nothing happens that beat. Near 7th: special 2 (not helpless) for 4 s: 8 ticks, 500 ms apart, the first 45 frames after the beat: up to 10 fighting units within 5 tiles take its attack, thrown 5. Plain beats, near or far: it throws a trident (projectile 135), standing helpless 30 frames, the trident leaving at the end of that second.
needs: Charge strike: the ghosts points with a kill rule: the first unit struck with max life < 500 is thrown 12 and dies on landing; before that one is found, units struck take 500 fixed points; after, its attack. Skip the beat entirely when there is no free tile ahead to charge to.
Split counters (near and far, 7 each).
Plain throw: helpless 30 frames each beat, the trident leaving after them.

beats.name: Demolisher Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter, 1 to 16. 8th: special 1 (helpless), frame 49: its own tile and 8 tiles ahead; around each point up to 10 fighting units within 4 tiles take 1.2 x attack (once per point), are thrown 5, and are knocked down when they land. 16th: special 2 (helpless): 5 ticks, 500 ms apart, the first 22 frames after the beat: up to 6 fighting units within 8 tiles take 1.4 x attack, thrown 5. The original's timer asks for 2.8 s but runs whole half-seconds, so 5 ticks.
needs: Throw then knock down: units struck by the hammer are thrown 5 and, on landing, knocked down (our usual knock-down: population under 4, no boss, not enlarged).

beats.name: Devil Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter over all beats, a cycle of 13: beat 7 a weapon smash, beat 13 a whirlwind, the rest plain blows by hand for its attack (its reach is 4, still no shot). Smash (special 1, frame 13, not helpless): walks its own tile then 4 tiles in the way it faces, and at each takes the fighting enemy units within 4 tiles, nearest first; it stops after 4 hits, and the same unit can be hit again from the next point. The first of them whose max life is under 500 is thrown 8 tiles and killed when it lands (no other damage); the rest take 1.2 x attack and are not thrown. The blast above (4 nearest within 4, 1.2 x) is the near-equivalent minus the kill. Whirlwind (special 2, it stands helpless for it): 4 pulses 0.75 s apart starting ~0.8 s in (frames ~24, 46, 68, 90), each: up to 5 fighting enemy units within 5 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 5. Map right.
needs: Smash kill: on the smash, the first enemy unit hit whose max life is under 500 takes no damage but is thrown 8 tiles and dies when it lands (one per smash); the other hits are 1.2 x attack, not thrown. Hits come from points along its facing (own tile + 4 ahead), radius 4 around each, nearest first, stop after 4 hits in all, repeats allowed.
Self helpless for the whirlwind (about 92 frames from the beat): it neither walks nor beats.

beats.name: Centaur Gladiator
beats.notes: Two counters: far beats (target more than 2 tiles, Chebyshev over footprints) and near beats (2 or less) each count on their own. Far: 5th far beat a net, 10th a super trident, then the far count restarts; near: every 5th near beat a smash. Plain beats: a trident shot (projectile 138) 15 frames after the swing, dropped if the swing was cut short. Net (special 2, helpless, frame 32): only if the target is a unit whose max life is under 500, else that beat is a plain trident (the count still moves on). The net (projectile 137, speed 18, no damage) holds the unit helpless 5 s (150 frames) under a net; the original sets it helpless before calling its knock-down, so no knock-down plays. Super trident (special 1, helpless, frame 35; projectile 138 at speed 45, no damage of its own): on hit the target is thrown 6 tiles and takes 1.5 x attack when it lands; a target that can't be thrown takes nothing. Smash (special 3, helpless, frame 62): up to 5 fighting enemy units within 8 tiles that can be thrown: its attack, thrown 5. Map right.
needs: Net condition: on the 5th far beat the net only if the target is a unit with max life under 500; otherwise a plain trident that beat.
Super trident damage comes when the thrown target lands (none if it can't be thrown); ours hits then throws.

beats.name: Mace Gladiator
beats.notes: Only near beats (target 2 tiles or less, Chebyshev) count; every 5th near beat a ground smash instead of the throw (special 1, helpless, frame 35): up to 10 fighting enemy units within 6 tiles that can be thrown take 1.2 x attack and are thrown 5. Every other beat, near or far, throws its mace (projectile 130) 12 frames after the swing, dropped if the swing was cut short. Map right (radius 6, 10 at most).

beats.name: Knight Gladiator
beats.notes: One counter, a cycle of 16: beat 8 special 1, beat 16 special 2, others a plain blow by hand. Special 1 (helpless, frame 27): the 6 nearest fighting enemy units within 8 tiles take 1.2 x attack, none thrown (even ones in the air). Special 2 (helpless, frame 3): the 6 nearest within 8 that can be thrown take 1.4 x attack and are thrown 5. Map right but vague: the reach is 8 tiles, 6 at most.

beats.name: Spearman Gladiator
beats.notes: Only near beats (2 tiles or less, Chebyshev) count, and only when it isn't busy. The counter starts at 0, so the first whirlwind is on the 6th near beat, then every 5th (11th, 16th...): n % 5 == 1 with n > 1 (the 'from': 6 key says so). It also needs the target to be a unit; if not, that beat is a plain spear and the chance is lost (the counter still restarts). Whirlwind (special 1, NOT helpless, but busy: beats in it do nothing and don't count): starts 20 frames in, then 6 pulses 0.5 s apart (frames 35, 50, 65, 80, 95, 110): up to 5 fighting enemy units within 4 tiles that can be thrown take half its attack and are thrown 5. Plain beats: a spear (projectile 128) 16 frames after the swing, dropped if the swing was cut short. Map right.
needs: Whirlwind only when its target is a unit (not a building); otherwise a plain spear that beat, and the count restarts anyway.
Busy for the whirlwind (about 110 frames): beats then neither hit nor count.

beats.name: Sword Gladiator
beats.notes: Every 8th beat (special 1, helpless, frame 23): the 3 nearest fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take 1.2 x attack and are thrown 5. Other beats a plain blow by hand. Map right.

beats.name: Anubis God
beats.notes: Counts every beat it gets while not busy (the base class drops beats during its specials without counting). 'Near' = target 5 tiles or less (Chebyshev over footprints). 8th beats: the bubble if near AND fewer than 4 of its converts are alive; if the bubble can't go, the 4th-beat jump is tried instead (so the engine must fall through when the bubble's condition fails). 4th beats: the jump if near. Far beats and the rest: its plain shot (golden dragon projectile 31, 12 frames delay). Jump (special 1, not helpless, frame 19): up to 10 fighting enemy units within 5 tiles take half its attack (rounded down) and are thrown 3. Bubble (special 2, helpless): see needs. Map right.
needs: Convert bubble: at frame 22 a red bubble appears (2 tiles right/down of it); ~16 frames later up to (4 - converts alive) enemy units within 5 tiles of Anubis, nearest first, with item life 350 or less, not a boss, not helpless, convertible, are removed (counted as killed) and replaced on their tile by a Mini Anubis (item 878) on Anubis's side, with its normal life, poisoned for good (Anubis's full attack every 3 s, 1000 ticks), helpless ~1 s while it fades in. Anubis stays helpless until the bubble has faded: about 112 frames from the beat. Converts alive are counted down as they die; 4 at most.
Rule fall-through: when the 8th-beat bubble can't fire (4 converts alive), the 4th-beat jump fires instead.

beats.name: Death Warrior
beats.notes: Near (2 tiles or less, Chebyshev): the counter starts at 0 and resets to 1, so the first sword slash is on the 9th near beat, then every 8th (17th, 25th...): n % 8 == 1, n > 1. Other near beats: a blow by hand for its attack. Far: EVERY far beat is the red beam (special 2, helpless, frame 25) and doesn't count; the beam fires only if the target is still within 3 x its reach (21 tiles). The beam (projectile 120, a 1 s beam) hurts when it ends: 1.2 x attack from the class plus its own attack from the shot (if it ends near the target), 2.2 x in all. Slash (special 1, helpless, frame 29): up to 5 fighting enemy units within 2 tiles of the target's tile (the target at the beat) that can be thrown take 0.75 x attack and are thrown 4, away from the Death Warrior, not from the centre. A near-beat beam branch exists in the code but can never be reached. Map: right, except it misses that the far beam is 2.2 x (the shot's own hit too).

beats.name: Punisher Knight
beats.notes: Counter from 0 to 10 then back to 0: a cycle of 11 beats, special 1 on beat 6, special 2 on beat 11. Only beats with the target within 2 count; its reach is 2 so all do. Far beats (can't happen) would do nothing. Plain beats: a blow by hand. Its onAttack doesn't check busy and neither special is helpless, so beats during them still hit and count. Special 1 (frame 8): see needs. Special 2 (frame 40): each tile of the 5 x 5 square around it, whatever enemy stands there (one per tile, buildings and villagers too) takes its attack, units thrown 4. Radius 2.83 picks exactly the 5 x 5 square. Map right.
needs: Front blow: the 3 x 3 square centred on the tile next to it in the way it faces (8 ways; a diagonal facing centres it on the diagonal tile). On each tile, whatever enemy stands there (units, buildings, villagers; one per tile) takes 1.5 x attack, and units are knocked down (population under 4, not bosses).
Special 2 also hits buildings and unarmed units on those tiles (one per tile); our blast takes armed units only.

beats.name: Soul Eater
beats.notes: Two counters (near = 2 tiles or less, Chebyshev). Every 6th far beat a purple beam (special 2, helpless for 1 s from the beat, frame 20): only if the target is still within its reach; a 0.55 s beam (projectile 116) that hurts when it ends: 2 x attack from the class plus the shot's own 1 x (if it ends near the target), 3 x in all. Every 6th near beat a smash (special 1, helpless, frame 31): up to 10 fighting enemy units within 3 tiles, not on its own tile, that can be thrown: half its attack, thrown 5. Other beats: a purple energy ball (projectile 115) 23 frames after the swing, dropped if the swing was cut short. It starts at 60% size; souls make it grow (needs). Map: mostly right, but the beam is 3 x in all, and growth goes in steps, not 5% per soul.
needs: Souls and growth: a soul is each enemy unit killed by its ball, and each enemy unit that dies at any later time (by anyone) after being hit by its smash or picked for its beam; each unit counts once. Starting at 60% size and attack 50: after 2 souls attack 55 and 70% size, then after 3 more 65 and 85%, then after 3 more 75 and full size; the soul count restarts at each step (the 3rd step may need 4 souls because of rounding: 0.70 + 0.15 vs 0.85). The new attack is permanent.

beats.name: Hurricane / Whirlpool
beats.notes: Each beat: up to 8 enemies within 3 tiles (anything targetable takes a slot, but only units with population under 6 are hurt): thrown 2, then its item's attack (config, rounded down: 1 for the Hurricane, 5 for the Whirlpool), and its own plain hit still happens (replace false). Each tile it steps onto: see needs. Note the Hurricane's attack is 1, so its step damage (attack / 3, rounded down) is 0. Map right.
needs: On each tile it steps onto: up to 8 enemies within 3 tiles (anything targetable takes a slot); each unit with population under 6 is knocked down (the knock-down here allows population under 6, not 4; bosses and helpless ones excepted) and takes its item attack / 3 rounded down.

beats.name: Souls Whirlwind
beats.notes: Never strikes on its beats. From the moment it appears: every 1 s (first at 1 s) up to 10 fighting enemy units within 4 tiles, not on its own tile, take half its attack and are thrown 3; after 12 s the pulses stop, it fades for 1 s and dies. That is 11 pulses (frames 30..330), maybe 12 if the timers tie. The Soul Colossus (its summoner) makes it unkillable (life never under 1). Map right.
needs: Timed aura from birth: whirl radius 4, max 10, half attack, thrown 3, every 30 frames from frame 30 to 330; not its own tile.
Lifetime: at 12 s it fades over 1 s and dies; can't die before (set by the Colossus).

beats.name: Evil Crows / Minion / Sand Storm Whirlwind
beats.notes: Its own beats are plain blows by hand (it hits by hand at any reach). It can't die (life stops at 1). From birth, every 0.75 s (22.5 frames, first at 0.75 s) up to 5 fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 4. 1 s after it appears, if it isn't moving, it walks once to the nearest enemy unit within 9 tiles (not a building, not helpless); the class never looks again. The pulses stop only when something outside (its summoner) resets it. Map: right except that it heads for an enemy once, not continually.
needs: Can't die: life never drops under 1.
Timed aura from birth: every 22.5 frames (first at 22.5): up to 5 fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 4.
One seek at 30 frames: walk to the nearest enemy unit within 9 tiles (no buildings, not helpless).

beats.name: Queen Beast Spawn
beats.notes: The Soul Eater's class, changed: no shots, no distance test. Every beat counts. Plain beats: a blow by hand. Every 4th beat it grows a step (after that beat's hit): beats 4, 8, 12 set its attack to 45, 55, 65 and size 70%, 85%, 100% (from 60%); then no more. From the 8th beat (once grown once), every 4th beat is an eat instead (special 1, helpless, frame 25): if the target is an enemy unit with item life 500 or less, not a boss, not helpless, it is held inside it and killed when the animation ends; if not, that beat does nothing. Map wrong: it grows every 4th beat, not every beat.
needs: Growth by beats: at the end of beats 4, 8 and 12 its attack becomes 45, 55, 65 for good (config attack 40) and it grows to 70%, 85%, 100% from 60%.

beats.name: Tornado Heaven
beats.notes: Its own beats are plain blows by hand (reach 5). It can't die (life stops at 1). Every frame (30 a second): up to 5 fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 4; when each lands it is shocked: 30 damage 5 times 0.1 s apart (only while the whirlwind is in its attack animation, and not if already shocked). Slip in the original: a thrown unit keeps its tile until it lands (about 1 s), so it keeps taking the full attack every frame in flight, up to ~30 times. A unit that can't be thrown (boss, giant, enlarged, already helpless) leaves no landing signal and the code errors on it, which likely ends that frame's loop (the boss is hit, the ones after it skip that frame). Map right.
needs: Can't die: life never drops under 1.
Every-frame aura: up to 5 fighting enemy units within 3 tiles that can be thrown take its attack and are thrown 4 (no cooldown: in-flight units keep their tile and keep being hit).
Shock on landing: 30 damage x 5, every 3 frames, stops if the whirlwind isn't in its attack animation; not if already shocked.
